tracks.title: King Conker
tracks.subject: a primary-school caretaker who spends September soaking and baking conkers from the playground horse chestnut, is handed a conker from the organisers' bucket at the World Conker Championships in Southwick, wins round one and loses round two to a girl from his own school
tracks.caption: Theatrical arena hard rock with 80s glam-metal polish, in the mid-2020s masked-rock-band style. Twin harmonised lead guitars playing a climbing melodic riff and a tapped solo; a chugging palm-muted rhythm guitar under big live drums with a booming tom fill into every chorus; a cathedral pipe organ and bright 80s polysynth stabs doubling the riff; a large mixed choir stacked behind the chorus. Huge glossy arena mix with long plate reverb on the snare and a clean, punchy low end. Male baritone-tenor lead with a smooth, theatrical, slightly sinister croon in the verses that opens into a full-chested melodic belt, the choir answering him. 116 BPM, E minor. Grandiose, swaggering and tongue-in-cheek. No screamed vocals, no nu-metal, no autotune, no trap drums, no pop-punk.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - pipe organ and choir swell, then twin harmony guitars]

[Verse 1]
All September I stood guard beneath the horse chestnut tree
Every kid at St Mary's knows the big ones belong to me
Seven nights in malt vinegar, an hour on gas mark two
Swinging at a sock on a string in the shed till my knuckles were black and blue

[Pre-Chorus]
Then a steward down in Southwick takes my biscuit tin away
Says the conkers come from the bucket, mate, swing what you're dealt today

[Chorus]
Bow down to the King of Conkers
Kneel in the beer garden at my feet
Three swings each and I swing the hardest
With a nut from a bucket that's never been beat

[Verse 2]
Round one I draw a banker up from Bath in a Henry the Eighth crown
His mates are banging on the tables and the vicar has to sit down
He clips my lace, I square my feet, I bring it from the shoulder
Half his conker's in the hog roast and the other half's in Oundle

[Chorus]
Bow down to the King of Conkers
Kneel in the beer garden at my feet
Henry's picking shell out of his lager
And my nut from the bucket has never been beat

[Bridge - half-time, organ and choir]
Round two it's Lily from Year Six, she gives a wave and says hiya, sir
One swing and mine's in pieces, it was the nut, I swear

[Chorus]
Bow down to the Queen of Conkers
I'm kneeling in the beer garden at her feet
She wants the big ones off my tree next year
And next October she's the one I have to beat

[Outro - twin-guitar solo, choir holds the final chord]

tracks.title: Touch-Move
tracks.subject: a fifteen-year-old at an under-sixteens rapidplay chess tournament in a Croydon school sports hall who trash-talks only in his head because talking at the board is banned, hangs his queen and still wins on time
tracks.caption: UK drill in the London style. A sliding 808 bass with long pitch glides between root notes; skippy hi-hats in triplet patterns and late, syncopated snares; a dark detuned piano loop in a minor key; a low choir pad underneath; a ticking chess clock as a quiet percussion layer. Cold, dry, tight mix with the bass up front and the vocal close and dry. Young male rapper with a South London accent, deadpan, low and half-whispered, sliding triplet drill flow with short ad-libs, no singing. 142 BPM, F# minor. Cocky, deadpan and funny. No autotune, no sung R&B hook, no US trap, no grime, no boom bap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - detuned piano loop, sliding 808, a chess clock ticking]

[Verse 1]
Croydon on a Saturday, sports hall, orange squash
Under-sixteens rapidplay, fifteen minutes on the clock
Opp shakes my hand in a blazer and a clip-on tie
Can't talk at the board, so the bars stay inside

[Pre-Chorus]
King's pawn up two, he copies, I don't even blink

[Chorus]
Touch-move, no take-backs
Put your hand on it, then that's that
Knight lands on F-seven, fork, say less
Can't say it out loud, so I'm saying it in chess

[Verse 2]
Then I hang my queen, swear down, just leave her there for free
He looks at her, he looks at the clock, then he looks at me
Thinks it's a trap, so he thinks, and he thinks, and he thinks some more
I'm moving like it's blitz, bang, bang, slapping the clock by the board

[Chorus]
Touch-move, no take-backs
Put your hand on it, then that's that
He took her in the end, but he's down to one minute, say less
Can't say it out loud, so I'm saying it in chess

[Bridge - beat drops out, only the clock ticking and the 808]
Ten seconds, five, his hand's shaking on the rook
His clock hits zero, I've still got forty, look

[Chorus]
Touch-move, no take-backs
Shake his hand, then that's that
Down a whole queen and I won on time, say less
Now I can say it out loud: I'm cold at chess

[Outro - piano loop, 808 fades, the clock stops]
Good game, bruv. Where's the cheese rolls?

tracks.title: Call the Fridgie
tracks.subject: a female refrigeration mechanic in western Sydney fixing the coolrooms of four pubs and clubs on a 46-degree day in Penrith before the Friday rush
tracks.caption: Australian pub rock with punk drive, in the 2020s Melbourne band-room style. Two crunchy overdriven electric guitars through cranked valve amps, one stomping an open-chord boogie riff, the other slashing barre chords; a pick-played bass locked to the kick in straight eighths; a loud, roomy live drum kit with a cracking snare and a bashed ride; a gang of mates shouting the chorus back. Raw, loud, live-in-a-band-room mix with amp hiss and no polish. Female lead vocal with a broad Australian accent, shouted, sneering and cheeky, half-spoken in the verses and hoarse and yelled in the chorus. 152 BPM, A major. Sweaty, cheeky and triumphant. No synths, no autotune, no pop-punk gloss, no metal, no country twang.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - stomping open-chord guitar riff, drums crash in]

[Verse 1]
Forty-six in Penrith and the bitumen's gone soft
Ten past twelve the phone goes, the Railway's coolroom's off
Thirty kegs are sweating and every schooner's pouring froth
Publican's down on his knees, he says, love, I don't care what it costs

[Pre-Chorus]
Up the ladder to the roof in my steel caps and my hat
Belt the fan with a shifter and she fires up, just like that

[Chorus]
Call the fridgie! (Call the fridgie!)
Every pub out west has got my number
Call the fridgie! (Call the fridgie!)
No one's drinking warm beer this summer

[Verse 2]
Two o'clock, the bowlo, three o'clock, the RSL
Four o'clock, the Workers', and their ice machine as well
Every barman shouts my name like I've come to save the town
And the old blokes by the pokies want to shout me a round

[Chorus]
Call the fridgie! (Call the fridgie!)
Every club out west has got my number
Call the fridgie! (Call the fridgie!)
Not one warm schooner in Penrith this summer

[Bridge - half-time, bass and drums only]
Half six, back at the Railway, my shirt's stuck on like paint
He slides the coldest beer in Penrith down the bar and calls me a saint

[Chorus - gang vocals]
Call the fridgie! (Call the fridgie!)
She's off the clock, mate, try another number
Call the fridgie! (Call the fridgie!)
She's at the Railway with the coldest beer of summer

[Outro - riff stomps to a halt, feedback rings out]

tracks.title: Mile Nineteen
tracks.subject: a London Marathon volunteer handing out water at the mile-nineteen station at Canary Wharf, shouting the names written on runners' vests until the last walker comes through
tracks.caption: UK funky in the classic London style, as revived in the mid-2020s. Syncopated funky drum programming: a broken, soca-influenced kick pattern locked with off-beat rimshots, rolling congas and djembe, and a swung shuffling hi-hat; a deep rolling sub bass; short Rhodes-style electric piano stabs on minor chords; a dry wooden marimba riff; a referee whistle used sparingly. Clean, punchy, club-ready mix with dry percussion and a warm sub. Bright, soulful female lead, conversational and rhythmic in the verses and belting in the hook, with a male crew shouting the call-and-response. 128 BPM, A minor. Joyful, sweaty and generous. No four-to-the-floor house kick, no afro house, no amapiano log drums, no trap drums, no autotune, no big-room EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - congas, shuffling hi-hats, marimba riff, a whistle]

[Verse 1]
Six a.m., Canary Wharf, the tables in a row
High-vis on, water stacked to my chin, and they tell me, hand it, don't throw
Ten o'clock the fast ones pass, they never turn their heads
By noon, here comes the river, fifty thousand vests

[Pre-Chorus]
Arms out, arms out, here they come

[Chorus]
Mile nineteen! (Keep it moving!)
Grab a bottle, grab two, don't stop to say thanks
Mile nineteen! (Keep it moving!)
Seven more miles, babe, you're nearly there

[Verse 2]
Here's a rhino, here's a nurse in a long blue dress
Here's a teapot with Dave in gaffer tape across his chest
Everybody's got their name on, so I shout it like I know them
Come on, Dave! Come on, Priya! Rhino, have a drink, go on

[Chorus]
Mile nineteen! (Keep it moving!)
Come on, Dave, come on, Priya, here, take two
Mile nineteen! (Keep it moving!)
Seven more miles and the Mall's waiting for you

[Bridge - drums drop to congas and electric piano]
Half past four, the tables folding, one lady walking on her own
I give her the last cold bottle and I walk her to the cones

[Chorus]
Mile nineteen! (Keep it moving!)
Last bottle's yours, love, no rush, take your time
Mile nineteen! (Keep it moving!)
Seven more miles, and they're holding the finish line

[Outro - percussion breakdown, whistle]
Keep it moving, keep it moving

tracks.title: I'll Write It Down
tracks.subject: a husband of twenty-two years who drives his amateur-astronomer wife to Borrego Springs every August for the Perseids and writes down every meteor she calls out, though he never sees one himself
tracks.caption: Late-70s West Coast yacht rock, smooth soft rock with jazz-chord voicings. A Fender Rhodes playing lush major-seventh and ninth chords; a melodic electric bass with sliding fills; a clean, chorused electric guitar with short answering licks and a brief melodic solo; tight, laid-back session drums with a crisp snare and a closed hi-hat; a tenor saxophone answering the vocal and taking the bridge. Warm, glossy analog studio mix with soft compression and wide stacked backing vocals. Male lead with a husky blue-eyed-soul baritone in the verses and stacked falsetto harmonies in the chorus. 96 BPM, D major. Warm, tender and devoted. No synthwave arpeggios, no trap drums, no autotune, no country twang, no disco four-on-the-floor.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Rhodes chords, a bass slide, a soft sax phrase]

[Verse 1]
Three hours out of LA, down the Montezuma Grade
Borrego keeps its porch lights low, it's ninety, half past eight
Two lawn chairs in the creosote, your clipboard on my knee
You take the sky, I take the pen, the cooler full of iced tea

[Pre-Chorus]
No moon tonight, you lean back and say, ready
I switch the red light on and hold the pen steady

[Chorus]
Call it, I'll write it down
You keep your eyes up, I'll keep the time
Call it, I'll write it down
I never see a single one, but they're all in my handwriting

[Verse 2]
Two-oh-nine, you whisper, a bright one, minus two
Green, with a trail that hangs there, and I miss it, like I do
At four the desert finally cools, I put the blanket on your feet
Seventy-one on the tally sheet, your coffee cold beside your seat

[Chorus]
Call it, I'll write it down
You keep your eyes up, I'll keep the time
Call it, I'll write it down
Seventy-two, you say, and I write seventy-two

[Bridge - sax solo, then voice over Rhodes]
Twenty-two Augusts, the same two chairs, the same sand in the cooler
You send the count off in the morning with my name down as recorder

[Chorus]
Call it, I'll write it down
Sun's coming up behind the badlands now
Call it, I'll write it down
Last one, you say, and I believe you every year

[Outro - falsetto harmonies and Rhodes fade out]

tracks.title: Tempa Lagi
tracks.subject: the youngest of five hammermen in a gong smithy in Wirun, Sukoharjo, forging a ninety-centimetre bronze gong ageng for a Solo dance school over three weeks of charcoal fire and hand hammers, under old Pak Darmo, who grips the red-hot disc in long tongs and keeps saying it will not sing yet, until the morning he strikes it once and sits down while the hum fills the shed
tracks.caption: Indonesian 90s theatrical pop-rock in the late-1990s Dewa 19 manner, Queen-influenced and melodic. A grand piano playing broad sustained chords and a short descending figure that opens the song; two overdriven lead guitars playing a harmonized melody in thirds after each chorus and taking a twin solo; a melodic fingered bass; live rock drums with big tom fills into every chorus; stacked multi-tracked backing vocals answering the chorus lines. Big late-1990s studio rock mix, piano and guitars wide, roomy drums. Male tenor vocal, clear and slightly nasal, conversational in the verses, climbing to a full-throated high chorus. 112 BPM, E major. Sweaty, proud and big-hearted. No synth pads, no EDM drums, no autotune, no pop-punk, no trap hi-hats, no glossy modern pop production.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short grand piano figure, drums and harmonized guitars enter on the last bar]

[Verse 1]
Senin subuh di Wirun, arang di tungku sudah membara
Pak Darmo jepit lempeng perunggu pakai tang panjang
Kami berlima pegang palu, aku yang paling muda
Pesanan sanggar dari Solo, gong ageng sembilan puluh senti

[Pre-Chorus]
Palu turun gantian, satu, dua, tiga, empat, lima
Telat setengah ketukan, jari Pak Darmo taruhannya

[Chorus]
Tempa lagi, tempa lagi
Mumpung perunggunya masih merah
Kata Pak Darmo, gongnya belum mau nyanyi
Masuk lagi ke api, tempa lagi

[Verse 2]
Minggu kedua dia melebar, telapak tanganku melepuh
Sehari dua belas kali masuk api, biar nggak retak
Pak Darmo coba pukul, bunyinya kayak kaleng kerupuk
Bocah-bocah di pagar ketawa, kami pura-pura tuli

[Chorus]
Tempa lagi, tempa lagi
Mumpung arangnya belum jadi abu
Kata Pak Darmo, dia masih ngambek sama kami
Besok subuh kita bujuk, tempa lagi

[Bridge - harmonized twin-guitar solo, then half-time drums]
Kamis minggu ketiga dia dicelup ke bak air
Mendesis panjang kayak ular, uapnya nutup muka kami

[Chorus]
Jangan tempa lagi, jangan tempa lagi
Pak Darmo pukul sekali, lalu duduk diam
Dengungnya keliling bengkel, nggak mau berhenti
Kopi di gelasku bergetar sendiri

[Outro - piano figure alone, last guitar note rings out]

tracks.mood: bouncy, proud and a little cheeky
tracks.subject: a ten-year-old in scout troop Regu Kancil at his first Saturday-Sunday school scout camp, where the tent collapses before dark, the girls' troop next door mocks it, the instant noodles burn in the mess tin and his troop still wins the whistle morse-code game, whose message turns out to be 'take a bath'
tracks.caption: Indonesian children's film-song pop in the style of a 2020s animated-movie soundtrack, bright and singable. A bouncy upright piano playing on-beat chords; a ukulele strumming quick sixteenths; a glockenspiel doubling the chorus melody; live drums with a light snare and handclaps on two and four; a small string section playing pizzicato in the verses and long bowed lines in the chorus. Clean, warm soundtrack production, uncluttered and cheerful. Young boy lead vocal around ten years old, clear and unforced, a young girl answering in the pre-choruses, and a mixed children's choir joining on every chorus. 124 BPM, G major. Bouncy, proud and a little cheeky. No EDM drop, no trap beat, no autotune, no adult diva belting, no rock guitars.

tracks.title: Kartu Pos dari Tampere
tracks.mood: shy, sweet and a little comic
tracks.subject: a young Pos Indonesia courier in Malang who delivers Postcrossing postcards from Finland, Taiwan, Belarus and Germany to the same woman every Tuesday, reads them at the red light, and finally buys a card at his own post office counter to invite her for coffee, which he then has to deliver himself
tracks.caption: Indonesian retro indie pop in the vein of The Lantis and Naif, nostalgic and gentle, with a slow-swaying 1960s-70s band sound. A clean semi-hollow electric guitar with a light amp-tremolo shimmer playing a sweet single-note hook; a semi-hollow guitar strumming steady chords; a melodic picked bass; a combo organ holding soft sustained chords; dry drums with rim clicks in the verses and tambourine on the chorus. Warm tape-saturated band-in-a-room recording, vintage rolled-off top end, light room reverb. Young male lead vocal, soft and slightly nasal, close and intimate, with a second male voice in two-part harmony on the chorus. 96 BPM, D major. Shy, sweet and a little comic. No synths, no programmed drums, no autotune, no city-pop slap bass, no surf-rock tremolo picking, no power ballad build.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clean guitar hook and organ]

[Verse 1]
Jalan Ijen, rumah tua, belnya sudah lama rusak
Tiap Selasa aku berhenti, teriak pos, pos, dari pagar
Kartu pos dari Tampere, gambarnya danau beku
Perangko rusa kutub, cap posnya agak luntur

[Pre-Chorus]
Bukan buat aku, aku cuma tukang antar
Tapi aku hafal jam berapa kamu buka pintu

[Chorus - two-part harmony]
Kartu pos dari jauh, satu lagi buat kamu
Dari orang yang nggak kamu kenal, tapi tahu alamatmu
Aku cuma kurir yang selalu telat lima menit
Yang diam-diam baca dulu di lampu merah

[Verse 2]
Dari Kaohsiung ada kereta, dari Minsk ada gereja
Dari Leipzig ada nenek cerita soal tomat di kebunnya
Kamu tanya, Mas, kok tahu yang ini dari Jerman?
Aku pura-pura lihat perangko, padahal sudah kubaca

[Chorus - two-part harmony]
Kartu pos dari jauh, satu lagi buat kamu
Dari orang yang nggak kamu kenal, tapi tahu alamatmu
Kamu ketawa di pintu, aku lupa pasang standar
Motorku hampir nyungsep ke selokan depan rumahmu

[Bridge - organ and tremolo guitar, drums drop to rim clicks]
Sabtu kubeli satu kartu di loket kantorku sendiri
Gambarnya Tugu Malang, perangkonya kutempel miring

[Chorus - two-part harmony]
Kartu pos dari dekat, satu lagi buat kamu
Dari orang yang kamu kenal, yang selalu telat lima menit
Isinya cuma, Minggu depan mau ngopi di Kayutangan?
Selasa pagi kartunya sampai, aku juga yang ngantar

[Outro - clean guitar hook fades with the organ]

tracks.title: Lima Sembilan
tracks.subject: a woman ham-radio operator on her Bekasi rooftop through the forty-eight-hour CQ World Wide contest, logging stations from Osaka to Rio and Alaska and giving every one of them the same 'five-nine' signal report, while her husband, who grumbles about the cracked roof tiles, brings up her rice and then spends the night replacing those tiles by torchlight under her antenna
tracks.caption: Indonesian 80s jazz fusion, keyboard-led jazz-rock with tight unison runs. A Rhodes-style electric piano with chorus comping syncopated ninth chords; a Minimoog-style synth lead playing quick unison lines with a clean fusion electric guitar; an electric bass slapping in the verses and switching to melodic fretless runs in the chorus; tight fusion drums with fast sixteenth hi-hats, ghost notes and tom runs into each chorus; one short odd-meter break. Crisp 1980s studio sound, dry tight drums, wide keyboards. Female lead vocal, agile and bright with a clear jazz tone, quick syllabic delivery, doubling the synth line on the hook. 132 BPM, F minor. Quick, playful and nerdy-proud. No smooth-jazz saxophone, no city pop, no pop ballad, no EDM drums, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short synth and guitar unison run over slap bass]

[Verse 1]
Sabtu jam tujuh pagi, kontes mulai dibuka
Antena yagi di genteng kuputar ke arah Jepang
Kopi satu termos, buku log, pulpen dua
Suamiku teriak dari bawah, gentengnya retak lagi!

[Pre-Chorus]
Si-kyu kontes, di sini Yankee Bravo Satu Alfa Kilo
Siapa pun yang dengar, jawab dong, sebentar aja

[Chorus]
Lima sembilan, lima sembilan
Dari Osaka sampai Rio, semua lima sembilan
Suaranya kresek kayak orang goreng tempe
Tetap kucatat lima sembilan, terima kasih, ganti

[Verse 2]
Malam Minggu di empat puluh meter rame banget
Jepang antre panjang, kujawab satu-satu
Ada bapak-bapak di Alaska, ada anak SMA di Polandia
Suamiku naik bawa nasi, terus ganti genteng sampai subuh

[Chorus]
Lima sembilan, lima sembilan
Dari Alaska sampai Kalimantan, semua lima sembilan
Ada yang nyaris nggak kedengeran
Tetap lima sembilan, ya namanya juga kontes

[Instrumental Break - odd-meter synth and guitar unison]

[Bridge - Rhodes and fretless bass under the vocal]
Seribu dua ratus kontak, suaraku tinggal setengah
Senin jam tujuh pagi, log kututup, aku tepuk tangan sendiri

[Chorus]
Lima sembilan, lima sembilan
Seribu dua ratus kali aku bilang lima sembilan
Suamiku nanya, sinyalmu sekarang berapa?
Kubisikin pelan, tiga tiga, ganti

[Outro - synth and guitar unison run, hard stop]

tracks.title: Lutut Kanan
tracks.subject: a forty-one-year-old former second-division striker nicknamed Si Kijang, hired for three hundred thousand rupiah a match to play for a village team in an inter-kampung tarkam tournament on a harvested rice field, his right knee strapped, kicked by nineteen-year-old defenders, until the ball bounces off the bad knee into the net
tracks.caption: Indonesian blues rock in the power-trio Gugun Blues Shelter manner, a heavy Texas-style shuffle. An overdriven Stratocaster through a cranked tube amp playing a boogie riff with wide string bends between vocal lines; a slide guitar crying over the chorus; a bass walking the shuffle locked to the kick; live drums in a heavy swung shuffle with a loose ride cymbal and rimshot backbeat. Live-in-the-room power-trio recording, loud amp, little gloss. Male baritone vocal, raspy and worn, half-spoken in the verses, shouted in the chorus. 118 BPM, A major. Gritty, wry and stubborn. No pop-rock polish, no synths, no autotune, no metal distortion, no dangdut drums.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - shuffle riff and a slide guitar lick]

[Verse 1]
Tiga ratus ribu sekali main, plus rokok sama nasi kotak
Pak Kades sendiri yang jemput, katanya cuma butuh satu gol
Dulu di Liga Dua aku dipanggil Si Kijang
Sekarang lutut kanan kubebat, turun tangga pun pelan-pelan

[Pre-Chorus]
Lapangan bekas sawah, rumputnya setinggi betis
Bek mereka umur sembilan belas, larinya kayak motor baru

[Chorus]
Lutut kanan, tolong tahan sembilan puluh menit
Habis itu terserah kamu mau bunyi apa
Satu kampung teriak, Kijang, Kijang!
Padahal aku lari pelan kayak bebek pulang kandang

[Verse 2]
Menit tujuh puluh skornya masih kosong-kosong
Aku ditekel dua kali, wasitnya sepupu kades sebelah
Ibu-ibu di pinggir garis lempar plastik es teh
Aku cuma nunggu satu bola, cuma satu, ke kaki kiri

[Chorus]
Lutut kanan, tolong tahan sepuluh menit lagi
Habis itu kita pulang, kukompres pakai es batu
Satu kampung teriak, Kijang, Kijang!
Kijang tua ini cuma minta satu bola

[Bridge - slide guitar solo over the shuffle]

[Chorus]
Lutut kanan, bolanya malah mantul di kamu
Masuk pojok, kipernya bengong, satu-kosong
Satu kampung teriak, Kijang, Kijang!
Yang ngegolin bukan kaki kiri, tapi kamu, lutut kanan

[Outro - riff stops, spoken over one last bent note]
Tiga ratus ribu, Pak Kades, plus bonus es batu

tracks.title: 放水始め
tracks.mood: sweaty, heroic and a little ridiculous
tracks.subject: a bicycle-shop owner in his town's volunteer fire brigade, drilling every July night behind the community hall under a captain with a stopwatch for the prefectural fire-pump drill competition, where a twisted hose costs them points and they finish ninth
tracks.caption: Japanese arena hard rock, the blues-based stadium style with riff-driven verses and a gang-vocal sing-along chorus. A Les Paul through a cranked Marshall stack playing a chugging palm-muted riff with pinch harmonics, then a fast, melodic wah-pedal solo; a second rhythm guitar double-tracking the riff, panned opposite; a punchy picked electric bass locked to the kick; live drums with double-kick fills and crash-heavy choruses; a Hammond organ swelling under the chorus. Loud, tight arena-rock production, stacked guitars, roomy drums. Male high tenor lead with a raspy, powerful belt and clipped, rhythmic phrasing, gang shouts answering the chorus calls. 146 BPM, E minor. Sweaty, heroic and a little ridiculous. No synth pads, no EDM drops, no autotune, no screamed metal vocals, no pop-punk, no anime-theme J-pop gloss.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - overdriven guitar riff, crash cymbals and a four-stick drum count-in]

[Verse 1]
七月の夜 公民館の裏
投光器の下 汗と蚊取り線香
昼間は自転車屋 油まみれの手で
銀の筒先を 握りしめる

[Pre-Chorus]
分団長が ストップウォッチ押して
「遅い もう一本」 これで十本目

[Chorus - lead vocal, gang shouts answer]
「放水始め!」 腹から叫べ
筒先構えて 腰を落とせ
的が倒れりゃ それでいい
誰も見てない 夜の練習でも

[Verse 2]
大会の朝 県の運動公園
アイロンかけた 活動服
敬礼の角度 膝の角度
審査員の 鉛筆が走る

[Chorus - lead vocal, gang shouts answer]
「放水始め!」 腹から叫べ
筒先構えて 腰を落とせ
的が倒れた その瞬間
四十八秒 自己ベスト

[Instrumental Break - fast wah-pedal guitar solo over the riff]

[Bridge - half-time, bass and drums under the vocal]
分団長は 「もう一本」と 言わずに
ストップウォッチを 胸ポケットに しまった

[Chorus - full band, gang shouts]
「放水始め!」 腹から叫べ
ホースのねじれで 減点くらって
それでも九位だ 胸を張れ
来年の夏も 公民館の裏

[Outro - riff, big drum fill and a final held chord]

tracks.title: 全員上がって
tracks.subject: a university student working as a municipal-pool lifeguard in a 38-degree heatwave, booed by the whole pool every time he blows the whistle for the hourly ten-minute break and cheered when he lets them back in
tracks.caption: Heisei summer mixture rock, the early-2000s Japanese mixture style that splices hip-hop rap verses onto bright, bouncy pop-rock. A crunchy overdriven guitar playing a bouncy off-beat riff with palm-muted chugs; a picked electric bass bouncing in octaves; live drums with a tight snare and a four-on-the-floor kick in the chorus; a cheesy square-wave synth lead doubling the hook. Loud, bright, compressed early-2000s J-rock mix with everything up front. Three male voices trading off: a fast, playful rap flow in the verses, a high clear tenor singing the chorus melody, and gang shouts on the call-and-response lines. 128 BPM, D major. Sun-baked, cheeky and bouncy. No funk clavinet or wah guitar, no metalcore breakdowns, no screamed vocals, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drop.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - bouncy guitar riff, octave-bouncing bass and square-wave synth]

[Verse 1 - fast rap]
三十八度 アスファルトゆらゆら
市民プールの監視台 俺ひとり
首から笛 赤いキャップ
日焼け止めは もう三回目

[Pre-Chorus - sung]
時計の針が 五十分を指したら
俺はこの町で いちばん嫌われる

[Chorus - high tenor lead, gang shouts answer]
「はい 休憩です! 全員上がって!」
ブーイングの嵐を 浴びながら
ピーッと吹いたら 夏が止まる
じゅっぷんだけ 我慢してくれ

[Verse 2 - fast rap]
聞こえないふりで 潜ったままの坊主
浮き輪にしがみついて 離れないチビ
プールサイドは 鉄板みたいに熱くて
みんな足ばたばた 体育座り

[Chorus - high tenor lead, gang shouts answer]
「はい 休憩です! 全員上がって!」
歩くコースの おばちゃんまで にらむ
ピーッと吹いたら 夏が止まる
あと五分 俺だって泳ぎたい

[Bridge - half-time, guitar and synth]
三時ちょうど 立ち上がって
もう一回 笛をくわえる

[Chorus - full band, gang shouts]
「はい どうぞ! 入っていいよ!」
今度は歓声 俺に向かって
ピーッと吹いたら 夏が動き出す
五十分だけ ヒーローだ

[Outro - guitar riff and synth, cut off]

tracks.title: 鳴らしてみてよ
tracks.subject: a flamenco guitarist who plays Friday nights at a small Spanish restaurant, finally handed the cypress guitar that the quiet luthier at the end of the counter spent two winters building, sized to her hands and with her name on the label inside
tracks.caption: Japanese flamenco-rumba pop, a J-pop love song built on Spanish rumba flamenca. A flamenco guitar with a bright cypress tone playing driving rasgueado strums and fast picado runs; a second nylon-string guitar on the muted rumba chop; cajón and layered palmas handclaps carrying the rumba groove; an upright bass on root and fifth; a breathy flute playing short flamenco-style phrases answering the vocal lines. Warm, close, woody acoustic mix with the handclaps spread wide and small-room reverb like a restaurant stage. Female alto lead, clear and slightly husky, intimate in the verses and opening up with light flamenco-style ornaments in the chorus. 108 BPM, A minor. Shy, warm and quietly giddy. No drum kit, no brass, no reggaeton or trap beat, no synths, no autotune, no timbales or cha-cha percussion.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - flamenco guitar rasgueado and palmas]

[Verse 1]
金曜の夜 スペイン料理屋の
小さな舞台で わたしは弾く
カウンターの端に いつもあなた
木くずのついた 袖のまま

[Pre-Chorus]
「次の冬には できるから」
それだけ言って 二度目の冬

[Chorus]
「鳴らしてみてよ」って 笑うから
シープレスの胴を 抱きよせる
かき鳴らしたら 客が振り向いて
あなたの耳が 赤くなる

[Verse 2]
弦の高さも ネックの太さも
わたしの指に ぴったりで
「いつ測ったの」って 聞いたら
「毎週 見てたから」 だって

[Pre-Chorus]
サウンドホールを のぞいたら
小さなラベルに わたしの名前

[Chorus]
「鳴らしてみてよ」って もう一度
今度はルンバで 返事する
手拍子が 店じゅうに 広がって
あなたは 下を向いたまま

[Instrumental Break - flamenco guitar picado solo over cajón and palmas]

[Chorus]
「鳴らしてみてよ」って 言うのなら
毎週 いちばん前で 聴いていて
カウンターの端は もうやめて
わたしの見える 席にいて

[Outro - rasgueado flourish and a final tap on the guitar top]

tracks.title: 笑われたら勝ち
tracks.subject: an apprentice chindon-ya in white face paint carrying the drum rig at her first All-Japan Chindon Contest in Toyama, botching her pitch for the July baseball All-Star Game so badly the crowd roars, and being told she will do the patter from tomorrow
tracks.caption: Chindon street band music, the Japanese street-advertising ensemble in its contest-parade form, a brisk 2/4 jinta march with an old kayo melody. A clarinet carrying the tune with a wobbly, singing vibrato; a chindon drum rig of a small brass kane gong, a tight shime-daiko and a medium taiko struck with sticks, rattling out the chin-don pattern; a gorosu marching bass drum on the downbeats; an alto saxophone harmonising a third below; an accordion pumping the off-beats. Dry, close outdoor street sound, like a band walking past on a spring city street, slight natural echo. Female lead with a bright, nasal Showa street-singer tone, quick and cheeky in the verses, belting in the chorus. 116 BPM, F major. Cheeky, nervous and festive. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synths, no enka-style kobushi, no orchestral strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - clarinet pickup, chindon drum rig and bass drum in a brisk march]

[Verse 1]
白塗りの顔に 桜がひとひら
鏡の中の わたし 誰だっけ
師匠の背中に くっついて
富山の朝の 平和通り

[Pre-Chorus]
胸のチンドン太鼓 ずしりと重い
ばちを持つ手が まだ震えてる

[Chorus]
チンドン チンドン 鳴らして歩け
口上ひとつ 噛んだって
笑われたなら こっちの勝ち
春の通りを 練り歩け

[Verse 2]
お題は七月の オールスター
野球のルール 実は知らない
「満塁ホームランで 三振だ!」
客席が どっと沸いた

[Pre-Chorus]
師匠のクラリネット 一瞬止まって
そのあと 誰より 大きく鳴った

[Chorus]
チンドン チンドン 鳴らして歩け
頭の中は 真っ白だけど
笑われたなら こっちの勝ち
拍手の中を 練り歩け

[Instrumental Break - clarinet and alto sax trading a jinta phrase over the drum rig]

[Chorus]
チンドン チンドン 鳴らして歩け
「明日から 口上は お前な」
笑われたなら こっちの勝ち
桜の下を 練り歩け

[Outro - drum rig rattle, gong hit and a final clarinet trill]

tracks.title: ただのカード
tracks.subject: a retired man who rides one-car local trains on summer weekdays to small-town city halls to collect the free municipal manhole cards, the only adult in a queue of children on summer holiday at the sewerage counter, until a clerk runs out in her sandals to show him the real painted cover on the crossing outside
tracks.caption: Japanese big band swing in the classic medium-tempo dance-band tradition, the sound of Japan's student and pro big bands. A cup-muted trumpet section playing soft, punchy figures that build to full-band brass hits in the last chorus; a warm trombone section with a growling plunger-muted trombone solo; a saxophone section led by alto playing smooth soli lines; a walking upright bass; swing drums on brushes in the verses moving to sticks on the ride cymbal. Warm, roomy, live-in-a-hall mix with the horns placed by section. Male baritone crooner, relaxed and conversational with a smile in the voice, gentle vibrato on held notes. 118 BPM, Bb major. Unhurried, amused and quietly amazed. No electronic drums, no synths, no autotune, no hip-hop beat, no lo-fi crackle.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - muted trumpets, brushed drums and walking bass]

[Verse 1]
定年して 三年目の夏
時刻表に 赤い丸つけて
一両だけの 各駅停車で
知らない町の 市役所へ

[Pre-Chorus]
二階のすみの 下水道課
夏休みの列に 大人は俺だけ

[Chorus]
一人一枚 ただのカード
表に町の マンホール

「お願いします」と 頭を下げる

[Verse 2]
カードの写真は ツツジとお城
色まで塗った 鉄のふた
「本物 見ます?」って 窓口の人
サンダルのまま 外へ駆けだす

[Chorus]
一人一枚 ただのカード
役所の前の 横断歩道
麦わら帽子と しゃがみこんで
「ほんとだ」って 声がそろう

[Bridge - plunger-muted trombone solo, then bass and brushes only]
四十年 電車で 通ったけど
足もとなんて 見なかった

[Chorus - full band, brass hits behind the vocal]
一人一枚 ただのカード
帰りの電車で 並べてみる
九十八枚 どれもみんな
毎日 誰かが 踏んでる絵

[Outro - saxophone soli and a soft final chord]

tracks.title: 맨손잡기
tracks.subject: two friends in shorts and festival T-shirts at the Hwacheon trout festival in January, betting dakgalbi on who can catch a trout bare-handed in the freezing pool and stuff it down her shirt before the whistle
tracks.caption: Miami bass idol pop in the 2024 girl-group style. A booming TR-808 kick with long sub-bass tails; rapid sixteenth-note 808 hi-hats and sharp handclaps; a clanking 808 cowbell pattern bouncing between the claps; a rubbery electro-funk synth bass riff; short, bright Juno-style chord stabs on the off-beats. Dry, punchy, bass-forward mix with crisp transients and close vocals, no reverb wash. Female girl-group vocals, light chest-head mix, playful talk-sung verses and chant-along gang vocals in the chorus. 130 BPM, A minor. Freezing, giddy and cheeky. No trap hi-hat rolls, no baile-funk tamborzão rhythm, no EDM build or drop, no autotune, no rap verse, no ballad breakdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - booming 808 kick, cowbell and handclaps]

[Verse 1]
일월 화천, 영하 십이 도
반바지에 반팔 티 한 장
수아랑 맨손잡기 내기했어
번호표 받고 풀장 앞에 섰어

[Pre-Chorus]
호루라기 삑 소리 나면
발끝부터 감각이 없어

[Chorus]
한 마리만, 딱 한 마리만
잡으면 티셔츠 속에 쏙
꿈틀꿈틀 배꼽 옆에서
소리 질러도 놓지 마

[Verse 2]
뭔가 손등을 스쳐 갔어
잡았다! 했는데 수아 발목
옆 아저씨는 벌써 산천어 세 마리
"삼 분 남았습니다" 방송 나와

[Chorus]
한 마리만, 딱 한 마리만
드디어 티셔츠 속에 쏙
꿈틀꿈틀 차가워 죽겠어
그래도 절대 안 놔

[Bridge - 808 kick and claps only]
구이터 가서 소금 뿌리고
닭갈비는 수아가 사기로 했지

[Chorus]
한 마리만, 딱 한 마리만
내년엔 두 마리 쏙
꿈틀꿈틀 생각만 해도
배꼽이 아직 간지러워

[Outro - cowbell and 808 kick, fading]

tracks.title: 뒤집기
tracks.subject: a small woman in the amateur women's ssireum bout at a Dano fair, facing the butcher who has carried off the twenty-kilogram sack of rice three years running, losing the first round to a belly lift and winning the third with a turning throw
tracks.caption: Dubstep-drop idol pop in the 2026 girl-group style: dark, sparse verses over a stomping half-time kick and finger-snaps, a tense white-noise riser in the pre-chorus, then a heavy half-time dubstep drop. A growling mid-range wobble bass with a fast LFO; a deep sub-bass that cuts out for one bar before each drop; a heavy half-time snare cracking on beat three; detuned saw-lead stabs answering the vocal. Dark, heavy club mix, sub and wobble bass forward, dry vocals with a short slapback. Female girl-group vocals, low cool chest voice, clipped chant-like verses, shouted gang vocals on the hook; the drops stay instrumental. 140 BPM, D minor. Swaggering, gritty and triumphant. No trap hi-hat rolls, no future-bass chords, no autotune, no sung melody over the drops, no rap verse, no traditional Korean instruments.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - white-noise riser over a stomping half-time kick and finger-snaps]

[Verse 1]
단오장 모래판, 맨발로 서
샅바를 허벅지에 감아
상대는 정육점 사장님
삼 년 내리 쌀 포대 가져간 사람

[Pre-Chorus]
허리 낮춰, 고개 박아
아직이야, 아직 아니야

[Chorus - shouted gang vocals]
밀리는 척, 한 발 뒤로
들어올 때 그대로 뒤집어
모래가 하늘로 튀는 순간
그게 내 판이야

[Drop - half-time growling wobble bass, instrumental]

[Verse 2]
첫 판은 들배지기에 붕 떠서
등에도 입에도 모래 한가득
천막 밑에 할머니들 웃어
근데 봤어, 사장님 왼발

[Pre-Chorus]
둘째 판 겨우 따서 일 대 일
쌀 포대가 천막 옆에 서 있어

[Chorus - shouted gang vocals]
밀리는 척, 한 발 뒤로
왼발 들어올 때 뒤집어
모래가 하늘로 튀는 순간
이번 판은 내 거야

[Drop - half-time wobble bass and saw-lead stabs, instrumental]

[Bridge - sub-bass and snaps only]
쌀 이십 킬로 어깨에 메니
사장님이 목살 한 근 얹어 줘

[Outro - half-time kick and sub-bass, fading]
내년에 또 붙자, 손을 내밀어

tracks.title: 조금 더 넓게
tracks.mood: warm, unhurried and quietly in love
tracks.subject: a couple on a weekend joinery course at a Seongsu-dong workshop building one two-seat wooden bench with mortise-and-tenon joints and no nails, each of them secretly moving the pencil line so the other person's half of the seat is a little wider, until the instructor asks why there are two lines in the middle
tracks.caption: Afro house idol pop, a tribal-percussion house groove under a K-pop girl-group topline, hypnotic and rolling. A soft four-on-the-floor kick with a tight shaker and rim-click pattern; rolling congas and djembe; a round sub-bass pulse; a looping marimba-and-kalimba motif; slow, airy pad swells that open up in the chorus. Spacious club mix, percussion spread wide, vocal close and dry. Female soft, breathy mid-range voice, intimate and conversational in the verses, a gently chanted chorus doubled by light female backing vocals. 122 BPM, E-flat major. Warm, unhurried and quietly in love. No Afrobeats bounce, no amapiano log drum, no deep-house Rhodes or organ chords, no trap hi-hats, no EDM build or drop, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, marimba-and-kalimba motif over a soft kick]

[Verse 1]
토요일 열 시, 성수동 공방
앞치마 두 개, 톱밥 냄새
못 하나 안 박는 이인용 벤치
일요일 저녁엔 들고 간대

[Pre-Chorus]
줄자를 쭉 당기면 백이십
가운데에 연필로 선 하나

[Chorus]
니 쪽은 조금 더 넓게
그 선을 내 쪽으로 살짝
모르게, 너 모르게
넓은 데 앉아 주면 돼

[Verse 2]
장부 끼우고 나무망치로 쿵
한 번에 딱 맞아서 같이 웃어
물 뜨고 와서 상판을 보니
니 손에도 연필이 있더라

[Chorus]
내 쪽도 조금 더 넓게
니 선은 니 쪽으로 살짝
모르게, 서로 모르게
선이 어느새 두 줄이야

[Bridge - kalimba and congas, pads open]
선생님이 안경 너머로 웃어
"가운데 선은 왜 두 개예요?"

[Chorus]
"서로 조금 더 넓게 주려다가요"
둘이 동시에 대답해 버렸어
들켰네, 둘 다 들켰네
넓은 데 비워 두고 가운데 붙어 앉았어

[Outro - shakers and pads fade]

tracks.title: 마지막으로
tracks.subject: a three-member high-school heavy-metal club that rehearses behind the chemistry lab and gets seven minutes at the school festival right after the principal's speech, which runs twenty minutes over until they are left with four
tracks.caption: 80s glam hard rock as played by a 2025 Korean idol rock band. Twin overdriven Les Paul-style guitars through cranked stack amps: a palm-muted chugging riff, harmonised twin lead lines, a pick-slide into every chorus and a fast tapping solo; a driving eighth-note picked electric bass; live drums with a big gated snare, double-kick fills and crash-heavy choruses. Loud live-room band mix, guitars wide and up front. Male tenor lead vocal with grit, high belted chorus lines and one short falsetto scream, shouted gang backing vocals. 152 BPM, E minor. Rowdy, sweaty and funny. No pop-punk bounce, no glossy pop-rock chorus, no emo, no synth pads, no autotune, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - twin-guitar riff, pick slide and a drum fill]

[Verse 1]
헤비메탈부, 부원은 세 명
음악실은 합창부 차지라서
과학실 뒤에서 앰프 켜면
비커들이 덜덜 떨어

[Pre-Chorus]
축제 순서표 맨 아래 칸
교장 선생님 말씀 다음, 칠 분

[Chorus]
칠 분이면 돼, 세 곡 다 해
스네어 찢어져도 멈추지 마
머리 흔들 줄 아는 사람
다 앞으로 나와

[Verse 2]
말씀이 이십 분째 이어져
"마지막으로"만 벌써 세 번째
베이스 줄 하나 툭 끊어지고
학주는 손가락 네 개를 펴

[Chorus]
사 분이면 돼, 한 곡만 해
솔로는 반으로 잘라
줄 세 개 남은 베이스로
끝까지 가 보자

[Guitar Solo - fast tapping over double-kick]

[Chorus]
사 분 지났어, 앰프 꺼져도
드럼은 아직 안 끝났어
앞줄 일 학년이 실내화를 흔들어
다 같이 소리 질러

[Outro - drums alone, then a shout]
내년엔 십 분 주세요!

tracks.caption: Korean jazz fusion in the mid-2020s Seoul scene, a band piece with unison bass-and-guitar breaks and a sung topline. A Fender Rhodes with light phaser playing extended chords; a melodic electric bass with slides and fills; crisp fusion drums with ghost-note snare, ride cymbal and busy tom fills; clean jazz guitar comping in the verses; an analog synth lead trading lines with the guitar in the bridge. Clear, dry, live-ensemble mix with room on every instrument, no gloss. Female alto, plain and conversational, close-miked. 104 BPM, B minor. Wry, steady and quietly proud. No city-pop disco groove, no smooth-jazz saxophone, no pop ballad chorus, no programmed drums, no autotune, no orchestral strings.

tracks.title: Ayah Paling Sado
tracks.subject: a 54-year-old school gardener from Alor Setar in the over-50 masters category of the Kedah state bodybuilding championship, spray-tanned the colour of teh tarik by his wife backstage, his children holding up a banner reading 'Ayah Paling Sado', placing third out of three entrants and lifting the trophy anyway
tracks.caption: Afroswing in the UK Afrobeats-rap style, sung and half-rapped in Malay. A syncopated Afrobeats drum groove with a muted kick, crisp rimshots and a busy shaker; congas and a talking drum adding fills; a clean electric guitar playing short palm-muted highlife licks; a warm, rounded sub bass sliding under the chords; soft Rhodes chords. Smooth, warm, spacious mix, percussion crisp and forward, bass deep but soft. Male vocal in a relaxed mid baritone, melodic half-rapped verses with a grin in the voice and a smooth sung hook. 102 BPM, G minor. Cocky, sunny and self-mocking. No trap hi-hat rolls, no amapiano log drum, no reggaeton dembow, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - shaker, congas and a palm-muted guitar lick]

[Verse 1]
Siang aku tukang kebun sekolah
Malam angkat besi kat gim Alor Setar
Dua tahun makan dada ayam rebus
Nasi lemak aku tengok dari jauh je

[Pre-Chorus]
Belakang pentas, orang rumah sembur warna
"Bang, warna dah macam teh tarik, cukuplah"

[Chorus]
Umur lima puluh empat, naik pentas
Seluar hijau, badan berkilat
Budak dua puluh tahun pun pandang dua kali
Senyum, Jamal, pusing belakang

[Verse 2]
MC sebut nama aku "Jamil"
Satu dewan gelak, aku lambai juga
Anak-anak angkat sepanduk depan sekali
Tulis besar-besar, "Ayah Paling Sado"

[Chorus]
Umur lima puluh empat, naik pentas
Seluar hijau, lutut bunyi "krek"
Budak dua puluh tahun pun pandang dua kali
Senyum, Jamal, tahan perut

[Bridge - drums drop out, congas and bass only]
Kategori Master, tiga orang je masuk
Aku dapat nombor tiga, tapi piala tetap piala

[Chorus - full groove returns]
Umur lima puluh empat, turun pentas
Orang rumah lap minyak kat dahi aku
"Esok potong rumput, jangan nak berlagak"
Nombor tiga dari tiga, piala atas kepala

[Outro - guitar lick and shaker, fading]

tracks.title: Seberang Papan
tracks.subject: a wife and husband married thirty-eight years, partners in the veterans' mixed-doubles carrom final at an Ipoh community hall, sitting across the board from each other as doubles partners must, where she reads his raised eyebrow before every flick, the opposing pair whispers that they must have secret signals, and on the last board she pots the red queen and covers it on his nod
tracks.caption: 1970s West Coast soft rock, a love song in Malay. A warm Wurlitzer electric piano playing gentle sustained chords; a clean fingerpicked acoustic guitar doubled by a jangling twelve-string; a melodic electric bass with rounded tone; relaxed live drums with brushes in the verses moving to sticks and a soft open hi-hat in the choruses; a clean electric guitar with light chorus effect playing a short lyrical solo in the bridge. Warm analog tape sound, soft and wide, vocal close, gentle room. Female alto vocal, warm, unhurried and slightly husky, close to the mic, with a soft male harmony joining on the last chorus. 84 BPM, E major. Tender, teasing and settled. No distorted guitar, no slow-rock power-ballad solo, no modern pop sheen, no synth pads, no programmed drums, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Wurlitzer chords and fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
Dewan orang ramai kat Ipoh, kipas siling pusing perlahan
Final beregu campuran veteran, meja paling depan
Kau tabur bedak atas papan macam tabur gula atas kuih
Lepas tu duduk depan aku, macam selalu

[Pre-Chorus]
Main beregu, pasangan kena duduk bertentang
Sebab tu aku hafal semua kerut dahi kau

[Chorus]
Seberang papan, kau angkat kening sikit
Aku dah tahu buah mana kau nak jentik
Tak payah cakap, tak payah tunjuk
Tiga puluh lapan tahun aku baca muka kau

[Verse 2]
Lidah kau terjelir sikit tiap kali nak jentik
Baju kotak-kotak tu, kau kata baju bertuah
Dulu kau kalah kat aku, bawah ketapang Batu Gajah
Malam esoknya kau datang, "Jom, main sekali lagi"

[Chorus]
Seberang papan, kau angkat kening sikit
Pasangan lawan berbisik, "Mesti ada isyarat rahsia"
Mana ada isyarat, cuma dah lama tengok
Tiga puluh lapan tahun aku baca muka kau

[Bridge - short clean guitar solo, then soft]
Papan terakhir, buah merah tersepit dekat lubang
Aku tak tengok papan, aku tengok kau

[Chorus - soft male harmony joins]
Seberang papan, kau angkat kening sikit
Aku jentik, ratu masuk, buah putih ikut belakang
Kau tepuk meja sampai bedak naik berkepul
Tiga puluh lapan tahun, aku masih duduk depan kau

[Outro - Wurlitzer and twelve-string, fading]

tracks.title: Main Je, Uncle
tracks.subject: a woman piano tuner in Kuala Lumpur called to an old hotel on Jalan Raja Laut whose lobby grand has not been tuned in seven years, who sits on the lobby sofa the evening before and hears the one thing wrong with it: Uncle Stanley, the lobby pianist, has been playing every song around a dead F sharp for seven years; she fits a new string, raises the pitch in two passes, and the next evening waits for his hand to land on the note
tracks.caption: Cinematic retro soul-pop in the 2020s British soul-revival style, a slow 12/8 soul ballad. A grand piano playing heavy gospel-tinged chords; a string section sweeping in at the chorus with long, rising swells; an open trumpet and a tenor saxophone answering the vocal with short unison phrases and long held notes under the chorus; a warm, round electric bass; live drums with a slow, heavy backbeat and a tambourine on the two and four. Rich, warm analog mix, big room reverb on the strings, voice dry and close. Female contralto vocal, smoky and powerful, restrained and wry in the verses, opening into a full soul belt in the chorus. 72 BPM, C minor. Smoky, patient and quietly amused. No jazz swing, no bossa nova, no trap hi-hats, no synth bass, no autotune, no rap verse.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short solo gospel piano chords]

[Verse 1]
Hotel lama kat Jalan Raja Laut, pukul enam petang
Aku duduk kat sofa lobi, beg alat atas riba
Uncle Stanley main "Getaran Jiwa", jari dia masih lembut
Tapi piano tu dah tujuh tahun tak ditala

[Pre-Chorus]
Satu benda je aku dengar, satu je
F sharp yang tengah tu, tak pernah sekali dia sentuh

[Chorus]
Tujuh tahun dia main, satu not dia tinggalkan
Tukar kord, lompat oktaf, lagu tetap jalan
Tetamu minum kopi, tak siapa perasan
Cuma aku yang dengar not yang dia tak main

[Verse 2]
Pagi esok aku buka penutup, cari punca
Tali F sharp putus, tergulung bawah penukul
Aku pasang tali baru, tala satu piano dua kali
Garpu tala ketuk lutut, A empat ratus empat puluh

[Chorus]
Tujuh tahun dia main, satu not dia tinggalkan
Malam ni not tu dah aku pulangkan
Uncle Stanley duduk, betulkan cermin mata
Tangan kiri dia masih lompat macam dulu

[Bridge - strings swell, horns hold a long chord]
Aku tak cakap apa-apa, duduk balik kat sofa
Lagu ketiga, rangkap akhir, jari dia tersentuh not tu

[Chorus - full belt]
Tujuh tahun dia main, satu not dia tinggalkan
Main je, Uncle, not tu dah ada
Dia toleh ke sofa, senyum bawah misai
Lepas tu dia tekan lagi, sekali, dua kali, tiga kali

[Outro - piano alone, one last held chord]

tracks.title: Kira Kepala, Faiz!
tracks.genre: Malay musical-theatre showtune (teater muzikal ensemble number)
tracks.subject: a young Malaysian tour guide counting heads on the Great Wall at Badaling on a packed October holiday-week day, with twenty-eight mak ciks from Tanjung Karang in matching purple tudung, one pulled into a Henan family's holiday photos, one reaching the North Eighth Tower alone ahead of everyone, one demanding her climbing certificate say 'srikandi' instead of 'hero', and the count always one short
tracks.caption: Malay musical-theatre showtune, a comic ensemble number in the Broadway style of a 2020s Kuala Lumpur stage musical. A bright pit orchestra: a busy stride-and-vamp piano, pizzicato strings that open into sweeping violins, a muted trumpet firing comic stabs between the lines, a glockenspiel twinkling over the top, and a brushed snare with cymbal hits on the punchlines. Clean theatrical mix with a wide stage feel, voices up front. Male lead tenor, clear and theatrical, patter-singing the verses as a harried young tour guide, answered by a female choir of middle-aged women singing in loud, cheerful unison and humming warm harmony under him on the bridge. 132 BPM, Bb major. Comic, bustling and warm-hearted. No pop drum kit, no synth, no autotune, no rap, no EDM, no rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - pit orchestra fanfare, glockenspiel and pizzicato strings]

[Verse 1 - Male Vocal]
Dua puluh lapan mak cik dari Tanjung Karang
Tudung ungu sedondon, kasut sukan baru beli
Beg penuh sambal bilis dengan cerek elektrik
Cuti panjang Oktober, Badaling sesak berasak-asak

[Pre-Chorus - Female Choir shouts, Male Vocal answers]
"Faiz, Tembok Besar! Faiz, Tembok Besar!"
"Ya, mak cik, pegang besi, jangan lari!"

[Chorus - Male Vocal and Female Choir, full orchestra]
Tudung ungu, dua puluh lapan, atas Tembok Besar
Satu keluarga dari Henan nak bergambar sekali
Satu, dua, tiga, semua mak cik buat peace
Kira kepala, kurang satu lagi!

[Verse 2 - Male Vocal]
Kira sekali, dua puluh tujuh
Kira lagi, dua puluh enam pula
Mak Cik Bedah kena tarik masuk gambar keluarga Henan
Mak Cik Timah dah sampai menara lapan sorang-sorang

[Chorus - Male Vocal and Female Choir, full orchestra]
Tudung ungu atas Tembok Besar
Mak Cik Senah beli sijil, "Tulis srikandi, bukan hero!"
Mak Cik Timah jerit dari atas, "Faiz, lambat macam siput!"
Kira kepala, kurang dua lagi!

[Bridge - Male Vocal, slow and warm, Female Choir harmony underneath, orchestra hushed]
Angin Oktober, daun merah gugur atas tangga batu
Lutut dah berbunyi, tapi tak ada siapa nak turun dulu

[Chorus - key change up, Male Vocal and Female Choir, full orchestra]
Tudung ungu turun Tembok Besar
Dua puluh lapan, cukup, bas boleh jalan
"Faiz, singgah kejap, nak cari itik Peking halal!"
Kira kepala, kurang satu lagi!

[Outro - orchestra button and a cymbal crash]

tracks.subject: a seventeen-year-old at a WCA Rubik's cube competition in a Subang Jaya school hall chasing his first sub-ten-second average of five, one solve lost when the cube pops a piece under a chair, the boy beside him explaining that the best and worst times get dropped
tracks.caption: Math rock with midwest-emo vocals, sung in Malay, in the twinkly Southeast Asian math rock style. Two clean electric guitars playing interlocking two-hand tapped arpeggios in 7/8 and 5/4 that snap back to 4/4 for the choruses; a melodic electric bass playing busy counter-lines high on the neck; live drums with tight stop-start fills, ride-bell accents and sudden full-band hits. Bright, dry live-room mix, guitars clean and sparkling, drums punchy. Male tenor vocal, earnest and slightly strained, talk-singing the verses and pushing into a cracked shout in the choruses, with gang vocals shouting along on the last chorus. 144 BPM, E major. Nervous, giddy and triumphant. No distortion wall, no metal breakdown, no pop-punk power chords, no synth, no autotune, no programmed drums.

tracks.title: 掠蛇阿傑 Lia̍h-tsuâ A-kia̍t
tracks.mood: swaggering, deadpan and proud of a small-town legend
tracks.subject: the ballad of A-kiat, a 23-year-old rookie at a rural Pingtung fire station whose calls are never fires: a hornet nest at the school gate, a cat stuck up a betel palm, then a two-metre cobra coiled on the uncle's leather shoes in an auntie's shoe cabinet, which he takes with tongs and a cloth sack and lets go at the foot of Mount Dawu, until the whole township calls him the Snake King
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien corridos tumbados in the modern Mexican sierreño style. A requinto guitar playing quick triplet runs and bent-note slides between the vocal lines; a twelve-string docerola strumming a tight, swung 6/8 rhythm; a tuba pumping the bass line on the downbeats; a soft shaker. Dry, close, live-in-the-room acoustic mix with the requinto up front. A laid-back male tenor with a slightly nasal, conversational swagger, telling the story straight-faced. 112 BPM, A minor. Swaggering, deadpan and proud of a small-town legend. No trap hi-hats, no 808 bass, no autotune, no rap verse, no norteño accordion, no pop ballad chorus.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
屏東庄跤 一間細間的消防隊
新來的阿傑 才二十三歲
消防衫穿好 想講欲去救火
電話一下響 是學校門口的虎頭蜂

[Pre-Chorus]
第二通 貓仔佇檳榔樹頂 落袂來
第三通 阿姨講 鞋櫥仔內有物件咧動

[Chorus]
掠蛇的 阿傑
一枝夾仔 一跤布袋
飯匙銃 頭攑懸懸
伊的面色 攏無變

[Verse]
阿姨徛佇 椅頭仔頂
手攑掃梳 喝甲規庄攏聽著
阿傑慢慢仔 共鞋櫥仔拍開
一尾兩公尺 捲佇阿伯的皮鞋頂

[Pre-Chorus]
頷頸 若飯匙 一下展開
阿姨 已經走到巷仔口

[Chorus]
掠蛇的 阿傑
一枝夾仔 一跤布袋
頷頸一下夾 尾溜一下收
阿姨佇巷仔口 拍噗仔

[Verse]
伊共布袋 囥佇車斗
載去大武山跤 放伊走
這馬規庄 蛇也好 蜂也好
電話一下響 攏講欲揣阿傑

[Bridge]
伊來兩冬 猶未救過一擺火
伊講 按呢嘛好
上好 一世人 攏無火

[Chorus]
掠蛇的 阿傑
一枝夾仔 一跤布袋
火 猶未救過半擺
規庄 攏叫伊 蛇王

[Outro]
阿傑 閣出門矣

tracks.title: 我佇下跤 Guá Tī Ē-kha
tracks.subject: a couple at a Kaohsiung indoor climbing gym on a Saturday afternoon, her first time on a rope: he ties her figure-eight knot and checks it three times, belays her up the red route, and when her foot slips halfway and she hangs in midair hugging the wall he talks her into sitting back on the rope; then they swap, he falls and his extra thirty kilos yank her off the floor so they both hang there laughing, and on her last try she slaps the top hold and turns to find him still watching her from below
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien bachata in the classic 1990s Dominican guitar style. A requinto guitar picking bright, syncopated arpeggios and short answering fills; a second guitar strumming muted chords; a punchy electric bass syncopating against the bongos; bongos playing the martillo pattern, with a scraping güira that opens up on the choruses. Bright, dry, band-in-a-room mix with the requinto and the voice up front. A smooth high male tenor, sweet and slightly breathy, with short melismatic tails at line ends. 134 BPM, D major. Tender, playful and quietly devoted. No drum kit, no reggaeton dembow, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no salsa horns, no pop-ballad strings.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
禮拜六下晡 高雄的攀岩館
日頭 對天窗 斜斜照落來
我共你的索仔 拍一个八字結
看兩擺 閣看第三擺

[Pre-Chorus]
你攑頭 看紅色彼條路線
兩手抹白粉 猶原皮皮掣

[Chorus]
你蹈 我佇下跤
索仔 佇我手內
若驚 你就放手
我會共你掠牢牢

[Verse]
蹈到一半 你的跤 煞滑去
索仔一下絚 你吊佇半空中
我講 免驚 坐落來 索仔有我咧
你兩手 猶原攬牢彼堵壁

[Pre-Chorus]
你喝講 緊共我放落來
我講 歇一睏 左跤邊有一粒通踏

[Chorus]
你蹈 我佇下跤
索仔 佇我手內
手若酸 就坐落來歇
我會共你掠牢牢

[Verse]
換你顧索仔 換我來蹈
我比你 重三十公斤
我一下跋落來 你煞予我搝起來
咱兩个 攏吊咧 笑甲喘袂過來

[Bridge]
你講 閣一擺 這擺我欲蹈到頂
頂懸彼粒紅的 你伸手拍一下
越頭揣我 我猶咧看你

[Chorus]
你蹈 我佇下跤
索仔 佇我手內
你欲蹈偌懸 攏免驚
後擺 嘛是我佇下跤

[Outro]
慢慢仔落來 我佇遮

tracks.title: 雞寮半暝 Ke-liâu Puànn-mê
tracks.mood: sweaty, rowdy and racing the clock
tracks.subject: a Yunlin chicken-catching crew (掠雞班) of seven racing to load 400 crates from a 6,000-bird broiler house before driver A-tsai's lorry has to leave at five for its slaughterhouse slot, while foreman A-gi stands on the lorry roof with his torch and calls every crate like a variety-show emcee, bringing on Auntie Tsu with four birds a hand without looking and the Su brothers stacking crates eight high as A-tsai checks his watch and honks; with fifty crates and ten minutes to go A-gi jumps down to catch too, and the 400th crate goes up on time while the rooster in the next village is only just crowing
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien Brazilian funk carioca on a classic tamborzão beat. A dry programmed baile-funk tamborzão drum loop with a booming 808 kick and slapping atabaque-style hand-drum hits; a deep sub-bass pulse locked to the kick; short, bright brass-synth stabs at the end of each phrase; a sports whistle blasting on the hooks. Hot, loud, punchy party mix with the voice up front. A brash young male lead in a half-sung, half-chanted rhythmic delivery, answered by a gang chant of mixed voices on the hook. 130 BPM, G minor. Sweaty, rowdy and racing the clock. No trap hi-hats, no reggaeton dembow, no autotune, no EDM drop, no phonk cowbell, no funk-rock guitar.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
雲林庄跤 半暝兩點半
六千隻雞 睏甲恬恬
七个人 喙罨掛好 雨鞋穿好
大卡車 倒退 靠佇雞寮門口

[Pre-Chorus]
工頭阿義 蹈起去卡車頂
手電仔一下照落來 各位觀眾 開工矣

[Chorus]
雞寮半暝 拚四百籠
雞跤 夾佇指頭仔縫
雞籠 一籠一籠 捒上車
阿義喝 噗仔聲催落去

[Verse]
第一位出場 阿珠姨
一手四隻 看都無看
第二組 蘇家兩兄弟
籠仔 疊甲八層懸

[Pre-Chorus]
司機阿財 一直看手錶
五點出車 晏一分都袂使

[Chorus]
雞寮半暝 拚四百籠
雞毛 黏佇目睫毛
阿財的喇叭 揤袂停
阿義喝 較緊 催落去

[Verse]
四點半 阿義徛佇卡車頂
逐籠攏喝 喝甲若秀場的主持人
各位觀眾 第三百籠
規班的人 衫仔澹甲會滴水

[Bridge]
閣五十籠 閣十分鐘
雞仔 一隻一隻 精神矣
阿義 跳落卡車 家己嘛落去掠

[Chorus]
雞寮半暝 贏過阿財的錶
第四百籠 上尾一籠 疊起去
阿財的車 五點準時開出去
各位觀眾 噗仔聲催落去

[Outro]
隔壁庄的雞公 這馬才咧啼

tracks.title: 算鳥 Sǹg Tsiáu
tracks.subject: a volunteer on the January black-faced spoonbill census at a Tainan fish-pond roost at half past five, counting sleeping birds through a scope in the north wind while a retired teacher clicks the tally counter, losing the count at 240 when a kite circles and the whole flock lifts, and starting again to find twenty more than last year
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien math rock in the melodic, bass-led Taiwanese style. Two clean electric guitars playing interlocking two-hand tapped arpeggios in 7/8 that snap into 4/4 on the choruses; a melodic electric bass carrying its own countermelody high on the neck; busy, crisp live drums with ghost notes and sudden stops; a glockenspiel doubling the counting phrases. Dry, bright, close studio mix with air between the parts. A soft, clear female alto, plain and conversational, with a lower harmony doubling the counting lines. 136 BPM, E major. Cold-fingered, patient and quietly delighted. No distorted power chords, no screamed vocals, no autotune, no synth pads, no post-rock crescendo, no indie-pop strummed chords.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
一月透早 五點半
北風 對魚塭頂吹過來
千里鏡 架佇岸頂
我的指頭仔 冷甲袂振動

[Pre-Chorus]
退休的林老師 提一个計數器
伊講 你算 我按

[Chorus]
一 二 三 四 五
一隻一隻 白甲若雪
喙 攏藏佇翼股底
算到一半 閣徙位

[Verse]
天光矣 才看會清
烏烏的面 若像毋捌洗
喙 若一支飯匙
佇水底 左掃右掃

[Pre-Chorus]
林老師細聲講 喘氣莫傷大聲
計數器 按到兩百三

[Chorus]
一 二 三 四 五
兩百三十一 三十二
一隻掃一下 閣睏落去
林老師 對我笑一下

[Verse]
一隻鶆鴞 佇天頂踅一輾
規片白的 一下攏飛起來
若像一領被 予人掀開
計數器 停佇兩百四

[Bridge]
落來矣 一隻 閣一隻
林老師 共計數器歸零
伊講 無要緊 咱重算

[Chorus]
一 二 三 四 五
一隻一隻 白甲若雪
三百一十二 算予清楚
比舊年 加二十隻

[Outro]
明年一月 閣來算

tracks.title: 削球 Siah-kiû
tracks.mood: breathless, cocky and laughing at himself
tracks.subject: a young line worker at a Taichung bicycle factory who loses every lunch-hour table-tennis game beside the forklifts to Uncle Hok, a 61-year-old forklift driver who holds his bat like a pen and chops everything back without moving his feet, with the workers betting their Yakult, until at five to one he wins a single game 11-9 and Uncle Hok says tomorrow he'll try
tracks.caption: Taiwanese Hokkien liquid drum and bass. A fast rolling two-step breakbeat with crisp ghost-note snares and a ticking ride cymbal; a deep, round sub bass gliding under the chords; warm Rhodes electric piano chords; a bright plucked synth riff bouncing like a ping-pong ball, with a short Amen-break fill into each chorus. Clean, wide, punchy club mix with the voice riding on top. A bright, quick male tenor singing half-time phrases over the double-time drums, with a group shout on the chorus score lines. 174 BPM, F minor. Breathless, cocky and laughing at himself. No trap hi-hats, no dubstep wobble, no autotune, no rap verse, no EDM festival drop, no neurofunk reese bass.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
臺中的鐵馬工廠 中晝十二點
便當 三喙就扒了
堆高機邊仔 一塊舊球桌
阿福伯 早就徛佇對面

[Pre-Chorus]
伊提球拍 若咧提筆
六十一歲 毋捌走一步

[Chorus]
我殺 伊削
球 轉甲若干樂
十一比三 閣輸一盤
養樂多 閣愛予伊

[Verse]
我暗時 對壁拍三禮拜
壁 予我拍甲落漆
今仔日 換一塊新的膠皮
阿福伯 看一下 笑一聲

[Pre-Chorus]
同事 坐佇堆高機頂
一人一罐養樂多 咧輸贏

[Chorus]
我殺 伊削
球 轉甲若干樂
十一比七 差一屑仔
賭我贏的 攏咧哀

[Verse]
十二點五十五 最後一盤
十比九 規間工廠恬恬
伊的球 摸著網仔才過來
我規身軀 仆落去救

[Bridge]
球 跳一下 過網
阿福伯 頭一擺 走一步
猶是 慢一屑仔

[Chorus]
我殺 伊削
球 轉甲若干樂
十一比九 我贏一盤
阿福伯的養樂多 換我啉

[Outro]
伊講 明仔載 伊欲認真

tracks.title: ฉายให้เธอคนเดียว (A Show for One)
tracks.subject: a husband and wife who have run the last single-screen cinema in Lampang for forty years, he threading the 35mm projectors upstairs and she selling tickets downstairs; on closing night he borrows a print of the film that was showing the night he first saw her from the Thai Film Archive and screens it for her alone in row F, deliberately missing the last reel changeover as he did in 1985 when he was watching her instead of the cue marks
tracks.caption: Thai 6/8 vintage soul ballad in the slow triplet-feel live-band style of 1960s soul, sung in Thai. A Wurlitzer electric piano playing rolling triplet chords; a clean hollow-body electric guitar with tremolo answering each vocal line; a round fingered bass guitar; live drums with brushes in the verses, switching to sticks and a heavy backbeat in the choruses; a Hammond organ swelling under the last chorus. Warm, close band-in-a-room mix with analog tape warmth, no gloss. Male tenor, warm and slightly husky, intimate soul phrasing in the verses with small melismas, opening up to a full belted chorus; gospel-style backing vocals join the final chorus. 62 BPM, E major. Tender, warm and quietly amused. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM synths, no string orchestra, no luk thung ornaments, no straight 4/4 pop beat.

[Chorus]

metas.prompt: Thai 6/8 vintage soul ballad in the slow triplet-feel live-band style of 1960s soul, sung in Thai. A Wurlitzer electric piano playing rolling triplet chords; a clean hollow-body electric guitar with tremolo answering each vocal line; a round fingered bass guitar; live drums with brushes in the verses, switching to sticks and a heavy backbeat in the choruses; a Hammond organ swelling under the last chorus. Warm, close band-in-a-room mix with analog tape warmth, no gloss. Male tenor, warm and slightly husky, intimate soul phrasing in the verses with small melismas, opening up to a full belted chorus; gospel-style backing vocals join the final chorus. 62 BPM, E major. Tender, warm and quietly amused. No trap drums, no autotune, no EDM synths, no string orchestra, no luk thung ornaments, no straight 4/4 pop beat.

tracks.title: ไดโนเสาร์คอยาว (The Long-Neck Dinosaur)
tracks.subject: a kindergarten class trip to the Sirindhorn Dinosaur Museum in Kalasin, where the children count the neck vertebrae of the long-neck sauropod skeleton out loud and keep losing count, a boy named Ton Kla insists a fossil egg in the glass case is his and wants to take it home to hatch, and the teacher hides behind the T-rex model and roars
tracks.caption: Thai children's sing-along song in the bright preschool kids'-TV style, sung in Thai. A bouncy strummed ukulele; a glockenspiel doubling the melody; an upright piano playing oom-pah bass and chords; hand claps and a shaker on every off-beat; a slide whistle sliding up and down on the jokes. Clean, dry and bright kids'-TV mix, voices up front. Warm, friendly female presenter voice singing in a child's persona with clear, slightly exaggerated diction, joined by a small children's choir that shouts the answers and the counting. 112 BPM, C major. Bouncy, nosy and proud. No trap beat, no autotune, no EDM drop, no rap verse, no heavy sub-bass, no luk thung ornaments.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - ukulele, glockenspiel and hand claps]

[Verse 1]
นั่งรถบัสโรงเรียน ไปกาฬสินธุ์แต่เช้า
ครูแจกหมวกสีเหลือง ห้ามถอดห้ามแลกกัน
เดินเข้าพิพิธภัณฑ์ ทุกคนอ้าปากค้าง
โครงกระดูกคอยาว ยาวกว่ารถบัสเราอีก

[Pre-Chorus]
ครูถามว่าคอของมัน มีกระดูกกี่ข้อ
ใครอยากนับ ยกมือ แล้วนับดังๆ พร้อมกัน

[Chorus - children's choir counts along]
หนึ่ง สอง สาม สี่ นับกระดูกคอยาว
ห้า หก เจ็ด แปด เงยหน้าจนคอเมื่อย
หัวมันสูงเกือบถึงเพดาน มองลงมาที่หนู
วันนี้หนูนับเก่ง ที่สุดในห้องเลย

[Verse 2]
ในตู้กระจกมีไข่ กลมๆ สีเทาๆ
ต้นกล้าร้องเสียงดัง ไข่ฟองนี้ของผมครับ
ผมจองไว้ก่อนแล้ว ใครอย่ามาแตะนะ
พี่ไกด์หัวเราะ ไข่ร้อยกว่าล้านปีนะหนู

[Chorus - children's choir counts along]
หนึ่ง สอง สาม สี่ นับกระดูกคอยาว
ห้า หก เจ็ด แปด นับไปนับมาลืมเลข
ต้นกล้ากอดตู้ไข่ ไม่ยอมเดินตามแถว
บอกว่ารอให้มันฟัก จะพากลับไปเลี้ยงที่บ้าน

[Bridge - lights down, claps only, then a big roar]
ห้องสุดท้ายมืดๆ มีทีเร็กซ์อ้าปากกว้าง

tracks.title: ลงตมนำกัน (Mud For Two)
tracks.subject: the builder on his village's team at the Yasothon rocket festival, whose bamboo rocket hisses and sits on the launch ramp, and the girl from the rival team who claims the right to throw him into the mud pit herself, then jumps in after him before her own team's rocket is lit
tracks.caption: Isan luk thung R&B, Isan luk thung singing over a smooth, laid-back R&B rhythm section, sung in Thai with Isan words. A phin lute playing a bright looping lai riff and fills; a Rhodes electric piano on soft ninth chords; a round R&B bass guitar sliding between notes; laid-back R&B drums with a soft kick, finger snaps on two and four and a lightly swung hi-hat; a khaen joining with chords in the choruses. Warm, smooth and close mix with light reverb, phin and voice up front. Young female mezzo, teasing and playful, relaxed R&B phrasing decorated with Isan luk thung ornaments and quick turns on the held notes. 96 BPM, A minor. Flirty, sunburnt and mud-splattered. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no rap verse, no EDM drop, no 808 slides, no brass section.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - phin riff, finger snaps and Rhodes]

[Verse 1]
บุญบั้งไฟยโสธร แดดเดือนหกแรงคัก
อ้ายเป็นช่างบั้งไฟบ้านโน้น คุยโวไว้ตั้งแต่เช้า
ว่าลูกนี้สิขึ้นสูง จนคนทั้งงานแหงนคอเมื่อย
น้องกอดอกฟังอยู่ข้างฮ้าน บ้านน้องก็ยิงแข่งเหมือนกัน

[Pre-Chorus]
พ่อใหญ่จุดชนวน ควันขาวพวยพุ่ง
คนทั้งทุ่งเงียบกริบ รอฟังเสียงมันขึ้น

[Chorus]
บั้งไฟอ้ายฟู่ ฟู่ แล้วก็นิ่งคาฮ้าน
ตามธรรมเนียมบ้านเฮา บั้งไฟบ่ขึ้นต้องลงตม
น้องขอเป็นคนจับแขนจับขาอ้ายเอง
นับหนึ่ง สอง สาม ตูม อย่าโกรธน้องเด้อ

[Verse 2]
อ้ายโผล่หัวขึ้นจากโคลน เห็นแต่ฟันกับตาขาว
คนทั้งงานหัวเราะ หมอแคนเป่ารับเป็นจังหวะ
อ้ายยื่นมือมาหาน้อง ขอให้ดึงขึ้นจากตม
น้องถอดรองเท้าวางไว้ แล้วโดดลงไปเอง

[Chorus]
บั้งไฟอ้ายฟู่ ฟู่ แต่ใจน้องมันพุ่งขึ้นฟ้า
ลงตมนำกันเด้อ โคลนเต็มผมเต็มหน้า
บั้งไฟบ้านน้องยังบ่ทันได้จุด
ทีมน้องตะโกนเรียก น้องเฮ็ดเป็นบ่ได้ยิน

[Bridge - phin solo, then half-time]
ปีหน้าอ้ายผสมดินใหม่ ให้น้องช่วยชั่งช่วยตำ
ขึ้นหรือบ่ขึ้นบ่เป็นหยัง ขอให้ยิงฮ้านเดียวกัน

[Chorus]
บั้งไฟอ้ายฟู่ ฟู่ แต่อ้ายบ่ได้กลับบ้านมือเปล่า
ลงตมนำกันแล้ว โคลนติดผมติดใจ
ปีหน้าฮ้านเดียวกัน บั้งไฟลูกเดียวกัน
สิฟู่หรือสิขึ้นก็ช่าง ขอน้องจุดนำ

[Outro - phin and khaen fade over finger snaps]

ว่าลูกนี้สิขึ้นสูง จนคนทั้งงานแหงนคอเมื่อย
น้องกอดอกฟังอยู่ข้างฮ้าน บ้านน้องก็ยิงแข่งเหมือนกัน

พ่อใหญ่จุดชนวน ควันขาวพวยพุ่ง

[Chorus]
บั้งไฟอ้ายฟู่ ฟู่ แล้วก็นิ่งคาฮ้าน
ตามธรรมเนียมบ้านเฮา บั้งไฟบ่ขึ้นต้องลงตม
น้องขอเป็นคนจับแขนจับขาอ้ายเอง
นับหนึ่ง สอง สาม ตูม อย่าโกรธน้องเด้อ

อ้ายโผล่หัวขึ้นจากโคลน เห็นแต่ฟันกับตาขาว
คนทั้งงานหัวเราะ หมอแคนเป่ารับเป็นจังหวะ
อ้ายยื่นมือมาหาน้อง ขอให้ดึงขึ้นจากตม
น้องถอดรองเท้าวางไว้ แล้วโดดลงไปเอง
[Chorus]
บั้งไฟอ้ายฟู่ ฟู่ แต่ใจน้องมันพุ่งขึ้นฟ้า
ลงตมนำกันเด้อ โคลนเต็มผมเต็มหน้า
บั้งไฟบ้านน้องยังบ่ทันได้จุด
ทีมน้องตะโกนเรียก น้องเฮ็ดเป็นบ่ได้ยิน

ปีหน้าอ้ายผสมดินใหม่ ให้น้องช่วยชั่งช่วยตำ
ขึ้นหรือบ่ขึ้นบ่เป็นหยัง ขอให้ยิงฮ้านเดียวกัน
[Chorus]

ปีหน้าฮ้านเดียวกัน บั้งไฟลูกเดียวกัน
สิฟู่หรือสิขึ้นก็ช่าง ขอน้องจุดนำ
[Outro - phin and khaen fade over finger snaps]

tracks.title: สามหมื่นเมตร (Thirty Thousand Metres)
tracks.subject: a Mathayom 5 girl in a provincial school science club who spent a year's lunch money on a weather balloon carrying a small camera, sitting on the school football field the night before the launch and wanting to see her own town from thirty kilometres up
tracks.caption: Musical-theatre 'I Want' song, a solo heroine's book-musical number with a pit orchestra, sung in Thai. A pit-orchestra grand piano driving steady eighth-note chords; a string section playing pizzicato under the verses and opening into sweeping legato lines in the choruses; French horns and trumpets swelling at each climax; a snare drum march and timpani rolls under the countdown bridge; a celesta sparkling on the high lines. Wide theatre-orchestra sound with natural hall reverb, the voice close and dry in front. Young female soprano-belter, bright and conversational in the verses like musical-theatre patter, building to a full chest-voice belt and a long held top note, with one key change up a semitone before the last chorus. 120 BPM, D major. Restless, nerdy and determined. No drum kit backbeat, no EDM synths, no trap beat, no autotune, no K-pop dance break, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - solo piano, then pizzicato strings]

[Verse 1]
ตีสองคืนก่อนปล่อย ฉันยังนั่งอยู่กลางสนามบอล
กล่องโฟมใบเท่ากระติก ร่มชูชีพสีส้มพับวางข้างตัว
เงินค่าข้าวกลางวันทั้งปี กลายเป็นลูกโป่งยางใบนี้
ครูวิทย์บอกว่าฉันบ้า แต่ก็ไปยืมถังฮีเลียมมาให้

[Pre-Chorus]
ทุกคนในเมืองนี้ เห็นเมืองนี้จากที่เดิม
จากริมถนน จากท้ายกระบะ จากหลังคาโรงสี

[Chorus]
ฉันอยากเห็นเมืองฉัน จากสามหมื่นเมตร
เห็นแม่น้ำน่านคดไปมา เหมือนเส้นด้ายสีน้ำตาล
เห็นว่าโลกมันโค้งจริง อย่างที่ครูวาดบนกระดาน
ขอแค่สองชั่วโมง ให้กล้องตัวนี้ขึ้นไปดูแทนฉัน

[Verse 2]
ชมรมเรามีสามคน คนหนึ่งกลัวมันตกใส่หลังคาบ้านใคร
อีกคนคำนวณลมทั้งคืน บอกมันจะไปตกแถวไร่อ้อย
ฉันเขียนชื่อโรงเรียนไว้ข้างกล่อง ใครเจอช่วยส่งคืนที
ฟ้าเริ่มสางเป็นสีเทา ครูเดินมาพร้อมไฟฉาย

[Chorus]
ฉันอยากเห็นเมืองฉัน จากสามหมื่นเมตร
เห็นหลังคาโรงเรียน เล็กเท่ายางลบหนึ่งก้อน
บ้านฉันจะเห็นไหมไม่รู้ แต่อยากลองหาดู
ขอแค่สองชั่วโมง ให้กล้องตัวนี้ขึ้นไปดูแทนฉัน

[Bridge - snare march, timpani roll, celesta on the count]
สิบ เก้า แปด มือฉันสั่นจนเชือกลื่น
สาม สอง หนึ่ง ปล่อยมือ

[Chorus - key change, full orchestra]
มันลอยออกจากมือฉัน ขึ้นไปสามหมื่นเมตร
เล็กลงเท่าเม็ดถั่ว แล้วหายไปในฟ้าเช้า
ทั้งสนามยังแหงนหน้า ไม่มีใครกล้าพูดก่อน
สายๆ เจอกันนะแก ไม่ว่าแกจะตกที่ไหน

[Outro - strings hold, piano alone on the last chord]

tracks.title: เทริดคือหมวกกันน็อก (My Crown's My Helmet)
tracks.subject: a Nora dancer hired by the provincial transport office to perform helmet verses at Phatthalung schools, who tells six hundred students his beaded crown is his helmet, then sees the headmaster ride off bareheaded and improvises a verse about him over the school loudspeakers
tracks.caption: Southern Thai Nora (manora) dance-drama song in the Phatthalung style, sung in Thai with a few southern words. A pair of thap goblet drums playing fast interlocking patterns that follow the dancer; a small two-headed Nora barrel drum punching accents; a reedy pi oboe looping a nasal melody; a mong gong pair and ching cymbals marking the cycle; trae wooden clappers snapping under the quick lines. Live open-air school-ground sound, percussion up front, the voice through a slightly boomy PA with a short slapback. Male Nora singer, high nasal tenor with a southern accent, fast rhythmic recited verses breaking into long ornamented held notes, a small troupe chorus shouting answers. 138 BPM, G major. Cheeky, fast-talking and sly. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no synths, no ranat xylophone, no luk thung brass, no pop vocal melody.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - thap drums, pi and ching, troupe shout]

[Verse 1]
โนรามาจากเขาชัยสน ขนส่งจังหวัดจ้างมาแหลง
หกร้อยคนนั่งเต็มลาน แดดเก้าโมงร้อนแทบสุก
ข้าตั้งท่าแม่ลายกลางเวที ลูกปัดเต็มอกสั่นกรุ๊งกริ๊ง
เล็บยาวงอนปลายเงิน ชี้วนไปทั่วลาน

[Pre-Chorus]
เด็กแถวหน้าตะโกนถาม ทำไมพี่ไม่ใส่หมวกล่ะ
ข้าชี้ขึ้นบนหัว ยิ้มแล้วร้องตอบทันที

[Chorus - troupe answers each line]
เทริดคือหมวกกันน็อกของโนรา
แพงกว่าหมวกพวกน้องตั้งสิบเท่า
ข้ายังใส่รำได้ทั้งคืน
พวกน้องใส่แค่สิบนาที ขี่ไปโรงเรียนก็พอ

[Verse 2]
รำเสร็จเที่ยงตรง ท่านผู้อำนวยการขึ้นมาไหว้ขอบคุณ
แล้วสตาร์ทเวสป้าออกประตู หัวเปล่าหน้าตาเฉย
ข้าคว้าไมค์เสียงตามสาย ทับรัวตามเป็นจังหวะ
ร้องสดออกลำโพงว่า ท่านลืมของไว้หนึ่งใบ

[Chorus - troupe answers each line]
เทริดคือหมวกกันน็อกของโนรา
หมวกของท่านผู้อำนวยการ วางอยู่ข้างแก้วกาแฟ
หกร้อยคนหัวเราะลั่นลาน
ท่านเลี้ยวรถวนกลับมา ยกมือไหว้ข้ากลางสนาม

[Bridge - thap solo, then trae and ching]
แหลงยังไม่ทันขาดคำ ท่านรัดคางแน่นสองรอบ
ขี่ออกไปช้าๆ เหมือนขบวนแห่โนรา

[Chorus - troupe answers each line]

tracks.title: Phun Muỗi Tới Rồi
tracks.subject: the smallest nurse on a Saigon ward health station's dengue-fogging crew, carrying the twelve-kilogram fogger on her shoulder through the alleys one Saturday after three dengue cases in alley 187: kids count her in as she pulls the starter and chase the white smoke, aunties slam their doors until they see larvae swimming in the water bowls under their own cabinet legs, and the crew clears the last alley just before the evening rush
tracks.caption: Euphoric hardstyle dance-pop sung in Vietnamese, Dutch-style festival hardstyle with a pop verse-chorus structure. A heavily distorted, pitched hardstyle kick with a long tail punching four-on-the-floor, with snare rolls and crash cymbals building into each drop; an off-beat reverse bass rolling between the kicks; a wide supersaw lead playing a chanting anthem melody, with a gritty screech lead answering in the drops; a twangy palm-muted electric guitar riff with a Western-film feel in the intro and the breakdown. Loud, wide festival master with a hard sidechain pump and a dry, punchy vocal on top. Bright, determined female mezzo, clipped chant-like delivery in the verses, full open belt in the chorus, with a gang of children's voices shouting the counts. 150 BPM, F minor. Triumphant, sweaty and comic. No trap hi-hats, no Vinahouse bounce bass, no dubstep wobble, no autotune, no rap.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - twangy palm-muted electric guitar riff, snare roll, distorted kick drops in]

[Verse 1]
Thứ Bảy, trạm y tế phường đi phun thuốc muỗi
Máy mười hai ký đeo vai, em nhỏ con nhất đội
Anh Tâm cầm loa, chị Hoa soi đèn pin vô lu
Hẻm một tám bảy, tuần rồi ba ca sốt xuất huyết

[Pre-Chorus - Female, children's gang shout on 'Một, hai, ba!']
Em giật dây đề, tụi nhỏ đầu hẻm đếm giùm
Một, hai, ba! Máy nổ ầm ầm, rung cả lồng ngực

[Chorus]
Phun muỗi tới rồi! Cô ơi, mở cửa ra!
Khói trắng tràn đầy hẻm, tụi nhỏ chạy theo la
Cô Sáu đóng cửa cái rầm: hôi quá, đi chỗ khác!
Còn năm cái hẻm nữa, em đeo máy chạy tiếp

[Verse 2]
Chị Hoa lật cái lốp xe cũ, lăng quăng lội đầy
Chị chỉ qua song cửa: chén nước kê chân tủ
Cô Sáu thấy lăng quăng tung tăng, la lên, mở cửa liền

[Chorus]
Phun muỗi tới rồi! Chú ơi, mở cửa ra!
Khói trắng lên sân thượng, con mèo phóng qua mái tôn
Chú Ba ôm lồng chim chạy: con chào mào tui sao đây?
Còn hai cái hẻm nữa, em đeo máy chạy tiếp

[Instrumental Drop - supersaw anthem lead and screech lead over the distorted kick]

[Bridge - kick drops out, guitar riff and handclaps]
Ba mươi lăm độ, khẩu trang, kính, ủng cao su
Mồ hôi trong ủng óc ách, anh Tâm hô: ráng lên em!

[Chorus - Female, children's gang shout on the countdown]
Phun muỗi xong rồi! Hẻm cuối khói tan dần
Năm giờ thiếu năm, xe máy ùa về kín hẻm
Tụi nhỏ đếm ngược: ba, hai, một, em tắt máy!
Cô Sáu chạy theo, đưa em ly trà đá

[Outro - supersaw lead, children's gang shout, hard stop]
Một, hai, ba... hết muỗi!

tracks.title: Dế Mèn Quá Hạn
tracks.subject: a Hanoi district librarian retiring on Friday who tracks down the boy who borrowed Dế Mèn phiêu lưu ký in 2014, works out his fine to the đồng including leap years, finds him at the fire station reading it to his crew on night shifts, stamps it returned and lends it to him again as her last loan
tracks.caption: Vietnamese musical-theatre showtune (nhạc kịch), a comic patter duet in the Broadway style of the new Vietnamese stage musicals. A staccato piano vamp; pizzicato strings with bowed string stabs on each punchline; a muted trumpet and a clarinet trading quick runs; tuba and snare drum swinging into an oom-pah march in the chorus; woodblock ticks and a triangle ding. Theatrical pit-orchestra sound in a hall, voices close and dry with every consonant clear. Duet: a crisp, brisk female alto delivering rapid patter, answered by a sheepish, warm male baritone, with a small male ensemble shouting backing lines. 132 BPM, B-flat major. Brisk, comic and warm. No pop drum kit, no synths, no autotune, no rap, no ballad slowdown.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - staccato piano vamp, pizzicato strings and woodblock]

[Verse 1 - Female, patter]
Ba mươi năm ngồi quầy thư viện quận
Thứ Sáu về hưu, sổ sách phải sạch trơn
Còn đúng một tấm thẻ: Dế Mèn phiêu lưu ký
Người mượn Nguyễn Văn Tý, lớp ba A, năm hai không mười bốn

[Pre-Chorus - Female, faster]
Năm trăm một ngày, bốn nghìn ba trăm tám mươi ba ngày
Hai triệu một trăm chín mốt nghìn rưỡi, tính cả năm nhuận!

[Chorus - Female with ensemble]
Dế Mèn quá hạn, quá hạn mười hai năm!
Đi phiêu lưu thật, chẳng thấy quay về
Thứ Sáu tôi về hưu, sổ phải khóa cho tròn
Dế Mèn ơi, về đi, cô chờ ở quầy

[Verse 2 - Female, then Male]
Ba ngày hỏi khắp phường, tìm tới tận đội cứu hỏa
Dạ, cháu là Tý, sách cháu để trong tủ đồ
Trang tả đôi càng mẫm bóng, cháu gấp góc từ lớp ba
Đêm trực rảnh, cháu đọc cho cả đội nghe

[Pre-Chorus - Male]
Cô ơi, tiền phạt cháu xin trả góp mười hai tháng

[Chorus - Duet with ensemble]
Dế Mèn quá hạn, quá hạn mười hai năm!
Ngồi xe cứu hỏa chạy khắp Hà Nội
Cả đội đứng nghiêm, xin cô tha phạt!
Dế Mèn ơi, ra chào cô đi nào

[Chorus - Female, softer, then full ensemble]
Dế Mèn đã về, đóng dấu đỏ: đã trả
Rồi tôi viết thẻ mới, tên Tý, hạn tuần sau
Cuốn sách cuối cùng tôi cho mượn trong đời
Dế Mèn ơi, đi tiếp đi, nhớ về đúng hạn

[Outro - Ensemble, oom-pah march, final cymbal]
Nhớ về đúng hạn!

tracks.title: Anh Ơi, Tuyết Nè
tracks.subject: a Saigon couple who saved one 500,000-đồng note a month for five years for their first trip abroad, seeing snow for the first time in Sapporo and building a cup-sized snowman on the hotel windowsill with a convenience-store mandarin for a nose
tracks.caption: Vietnamese chamber pop, a small-orchestra waltz love song in 3/4. A string quartet: violins plucking pizzicato off-beats and a warm bowed cello carrying the bass line; celesta and glockenspiel sprinkling high bell notes like falling snow; a clarinet and a flute trading a small counter-melody; a felt piano keeping a gentle waltz pulse; a soft brushed snare entering only in the last chorus. Intimate, close-miked chamber recording with natural room sound. Warm, light female mezzo with a smiling, conversational delivery, a little breathy at the top of the phrase. 92 BPM, A major. Giddy, tender and cold-cheeked. No 4/4 pop drum beat, no trap drums, no EDM build, no synth pads, no autotune, no power-ballad belting.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - pizzicato strings and celesta in waltz time]

[Verse 1]
Năm năm bỏ heo đất, mỗi tháng một tờ năm trăm
Bay chuyến đêm, sáng ra Sapporo trắng xóa
Em mặc ba lớp áo mà răng vẫn đánh cầm cập
Anh đứng giữa đường, há miệng hứng tuyết như con nít

[Pre-Chorus]
Ở Sài Gòn, nắm tay anh toàn mồ hôi
Qua đây em mới biết tay anh ấm cỡ nào

[Chorus]
Anh ơi, tuyết nè, tuyết rơi trên nón len
Rơi trên vai anh, rơi vô lon cà phê nóng
Sài Gòn lạnh nhất là mở cửa tủ đông
Lạnh vầy mới có cớ nắm tay nhau hoài

[Verse 2]
Em đòi đắp người tuyết mà đâu có cà rốt
Ghé cửa hàng tiện lợi mua trái quýt làm mũi
Ba phút tay tê cứng, người tuyết cao bằng cái ly
Để trên bậu cửa sổ, hai đứa đặt tên là Quýt

[Chorus]
Anh ơi, tuyết nè, tuyết rơi trên nón len
Rơi lên mũi thằng Quýt, rơi trên tóc anh
Anh quấn khăn cho nó, rồi hà hơi vô tay em
Lạnh vầy mới có cớ nắm tay nhau hoài

[Bridge - cello and clarinet, rubato]
Mai về Sài Gòn, ba mươi tư độ
Anh nói: tay ướt mồ hôi anh cũng nắm

[Chorus - brushed snare enters]
Anh ơi, tuyết nè, lần cuối trước khi về
Thằng Quýt trên bậu cửa đứng nhìn theo
Mình lại bỏ heo thêm năm năm nữa
Nóng hay lạnh gì, mình cũng nắm tay nhau hoài

[Outro - celesta and pizzicato strings, fading]
