tracks.title: Giọng Vịt Đực
tracks.subject: the only boy in a Phú Thọ lower-secondary school's hát Xoan club, made to hold the drum and lead the giáo trống call as the kép opposite twelve girl đào, whose voice starts breaking in February and squawks like a drake on the high note at every rehearsal; at the Hùng Kings' anniversary performance in the village đình it cracks again in front of the whole village, the twelve đào drown it out in unison, the front-row children quack along all evening and the village head asks him to keep the duck next year
tracks.caption: Hát Xoan folk-pop from Phú Thọ, a modern school-stage arrangement of the call-and-response spring songs sung for the Hùng Kings. A small barrel drum struck on skin and rim in the tùng-cắc Xoan pattern; bamboo phách clappers keeping a steady pulse; a sáo trúc bamboo flute answering each sung line; a đàn nguyệt moon lute plucking bright pentatonic riffs; a soft strummed acoustic guitar under the choruses. Warm, open school-hall acoustic sound with the drum and clappers up front. Call and response: a shy, earnest adolescent male tenor in the kép role, answered by a bright unison chorus of teenage girls singing the đào lines in a plain folk style. 104 BPM, D major. Cheeky, bright and springlike. No pop drum kit, no EDM drop, no trap beat, no autotune, no rap, no quan họ or chèo ornamentation.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - Xoan drum on skin and rim, bamboo clappers, sáo trúc]

[Verse 1 - Male]
Câu lạc bộ hát Xoan: mười hai đào, một kép là mình
Cô bảo kép đứng giữa, ôm trống, cất câu giáo trống
Tháng Giêng giọng mình còn trong, vút cao như tiếng sáo

[Pre-Chorus - Male]
Sang tháng Hai, sáng nào dậy cổ cũng như mắc sạn
Lên tới nốt cao nhất, mình há miệng ra... quạc!

[Chorus - Girls' chorus, then Male]
Giọng vịt đực! Giọng vịt đực!
Kép ơi kép, vịt nhà ai lạc vào đây?
Mười hai đứa đào cười rung cả phách
Tùng... cắc... mình gõ trống cho đỡ ngượng

[Verse 2 - Male]
Cô hạ tông, mình rơi tõm; cô lên tông, mình lại quạc
Mười hai đứa đào chụm đầu thì thầm, nhìn mình rồi gật gù

[Pre-Chorus - Male]
Giỗ Tổ mùng mười tháng Ba, sân đình cắm đầy cờ
Cả làng ngồi kín chiếu, mình ôm trống mà run

[Chorus - Girls' chorus, then Male]
Giọng vịt đực! Giọng vịt đực!
Lên tới nốt cao, cả sân đình nghe quạc
Mười hai đứa đào đồng thanh át luôn tiếng vịt
Tùng... cắc... mình đánh trống to hơn nữa

[Bridge - Male, over drum and clappers only]
Lũ trẻ ngồi hàng đầu quạc theo mình suốt buổi
Ông trưởng thôn vỗ vai: sang năm giữ con vịt nhé!

[Chorus - Girls' chorus, then Male]
Giọng vịt đực! Giọng vịt đực!
Kép ơi kép, sang năm giọng trầm như trống cái
Nốt cao để mười hai đứa đào lo hết
Tùng... cắc... kép cứ việc đánh trống thôi

[Outro - Girls' chorus, sáo trúc and drum, final drum hit]
Kép ơi kép... tùng... cắc... quạc!

tracks.title: Oxyz, Tha Cho Tao
tracks.subject: a Year-12 student in the last fifteen minutes of the national graduation exam's ninety-minute maths paper on a 39-degree June afternoon, three Oxyz geometry questions blank, a snapped 2B pencil and the invigilator's footsteps coming down the aisle
tracks.caption: Vietnamese death metal in the current Saigon underground style, with grindcore bursts and groove breakdowns. Down-tuned, buzzsaw-distorted rhythm guitars playing tremolo-picked riffs and chugging palm-muted breakdowns; a clanking, distorted electric bass locked to the guitars; live drums with blast beats, double-kick runs and a crashing china cymbal; a squealing pinch-harmonic lead guitar break. Raw, heavy live-room production, guitars thick but every riff readable. Male lead in deep guttural death growls, with a higher hardcore shout answering on the hooks. 180 BPM, D minor. Ferocious, panicked and comic. No clean sung chorus, no synths, no autotune, no rap, no pop-punk or metalcore melodic hooks.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - tremolo-picked guitar riff over blast beats, then a chugging breakdown]

[Verse 1]
Tháng Sáu ba mươi chín độ, phòng thi số mười bốn

Ba câu hình Oxyz trắng trơn trên giấy nháp

Mười lăm phút! Mười lăm phút!

Tô bừa hay tính tiếp, trời ơi!
Oxyz, tha cho tao!

[Verse 2]
Thằng bàn bên tô xong, gác bút ngồi ngáp

Vẽ hình lần thứ ba, vẫn ra cái hộp méo

Còn năm phút! Giám thị thở mùi cà phê sau gáy

[Chorus]
Năm phút! Năm phút!

Tô bừa đi, tô bừa đi, trời ơi!
Oxyz, tha cho tao!

Đúng, sai, đúng, sai, tô theo nhịp trống

Hết giờ! Hết giờ!

[Outro - final breakdown, guitar feedback, hard stop]
Mai còn hai môn nữa...

tracks.title: 行頭排
tracks.subject: a 42-year-old office worker who last played trombone in his school band in 1999, roped in by his niece, drum major of a Tuen Mun youth marching band, when the band's only trombonist flies to Osaka for Lunar New Year; marching in the front row of the Lunar New Year night parade in Tsim Sha Tsui he misses her whistle to halt, plays on alone into a squad of American cheerleaders, and ducks to the roadside until his band's bass drum catches up
tracks.caption: Cantonese 2-Tone ska, late-70s British ska revival in the Coventry mould. A clipped upstroke electric guitar skanking on every off-beat, a buzzy Vox Continental organ doubling the skank and stabbing short fills, a walking melodic bass, tight drums driving a rimshot snare backbeat on two and four under quick closed hi-hats, and a two-piece horn section of trombone and tenor saxophone playing unison riffs and one short trombone solo. Dry, punchy live-room recording with the band bleeding into each other's mics, no gloss. A cheeky male baritone, half-sung and half-spoken like Hong Kong shop patter, with band members shouting answers in the chorus. 152 BPM, Bb major. Brisk, cheeky, red-faced parade-night mix-up. No reggae one-drop, no distorted ska-punk guitars, no pop-punk, no synth pads, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
年廿八 外甥女打電話嚟
「舅父 你中學係咪吹過長號」
屯門個少年樂隊 得一個長號仔
佢成家人 年三十 要飛去大阪

[Pre-Chorus]
衣櫃頂 拎咗個長號箱落嚟
上一次打開 係一九九九

[Chorus]
推出去 拉返嚟
支管咁長 一定行頭排
前面淨係得 外甥女支棍
後面廿個細路 跟住嚟

[Verse]
借咗套制服 細咗兩個碼
件褸扣唔埋 頂帽細到坐喺頭頂
年初一夜晚 廣東道
兩邊啲人 企到成十幾層

[Pre-Chorus]
佢話 銀雞一響 就要原地踏步
我話 得啦 你放心啦

[Chorus]
推出去 拉返嚟
四十二歲 行頭排
啲閃光燈 一路對住我閃
銀雞響咗 我聽唔到

[Verse]
一路吹到 海防道轉角
點解成條街 得返我一支長號
轉頭一望 成隊樂隊唔見咗
原來我 行咗入美國啦啦隊中間

[Bridge]
三十個彩球 喺我面前搖
我縮埋路邊 等我哋個大鼓
佢支棍一指 我即刻歸隊

[Chorus]
推出去 拉返嚟
四十二歲 企返頭排
外甥女喺前面 頭都冇擰過
睇佢個背 就知佢笑到震

[Outro]
收隊嗰陣 啲細路叫我 啦啦隊舅父
下年 我實聽銀雞

tracks.title: 六件蛋撻
tracks.subject: six office friends dressed as a box of egg tarts in the South Stand at the first Hong Kong Sevens at Kai Tak, dancing all weekend and missing every try, including the one in the final
tracks.caption: Cantonese-language Brazilian funk carioca, Rio baile funk in the tamborzão style. A programmed tamborzão drum loop of electronic congas and atabaque hits, a booming distorted 808 kick with sub-bass, sharp hand claps, a referee whistle blown on the downbeats, and a short squelchy synth-bass stab answering each chant. Loud, raw, bass-heavy soundsystem mix, dry and in-your-face. A male and a female Cantonese MC trading short punchy call-and-response lines, with a rowdy crowd shouting the hook back. 130 BPM, F# minor. Rowdy, silly, sweaty all-day stadium party. No trap hi-hats, no reggaeton dembow, no EDM build or drop, no pop synth chords, no funk-rock guitar or slap bass, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
啟德新球場 禮拜六朝早
排咗三個鐘 先入到南看台
六個同事 扮六件蛋撻
最大隻嗰個 仲孭住個紙盒

[Pre-Chorus]
人哋問 今場邊隊打邊隊
我哋話 唔知 跳咗先

[Chorus]
蛋撻 蛋撻 跳到彈起
酥皮甩晒 都唔理
個波喺邊 冇人睇
南看台 我哋最大聲

[Verse]
隔籬班人 扮晒 Minion 同牛仔
後面成排 扮晒港鐵車卡
大螢幕 影到我哋六個
成場人 一齊叫 蛋撻

[Pre-Chorus]
人哋問 頭先邊個達陣
我哋話 唔知 跳咗先

[Chorus]
蛋撻 蛋撻 跳到彈起
個餡甩咗一半 都唔理
個波喺邊 冇人睇
大螢幕 再影多我哋一次

[Verse]
禮拜日 決賽終於開波
我哋六個 坐低想睇
孭紙盒嗰個 話去買啤酒
我哋陪佢排 排咗成個鐘

[Bridge]
成個球場 突然震一震
我哋喺走廊 聽到有人叫 達陣
六件蛋撻 攬住一齊跳

[Chorus]
蛋撻 蛋撻 跳到彈起
決賽達陣 我哋冇睇
個波喺邊 我哋唔知
排隊嗰度 我哋最大聲

[Outro]
蛋撻 蛋撻 聽年再嚟

tracks.title: 寫咗先望
tracks.subject: a shy man who sings the scholar's part in a Saturday amateur Cantonese-opera singing club in a To Kwa Wan community hall, paired for the annual show in a duet with the woman who joined in March, who only looks at her where the teacher has pencilled the word 'look' into his score, until on show night he opens it at the music stand and finds she has pencilled one beside every line
tracks.caption: Cantonese bachata in the modern romantic New York style. A bright requinto lead guitar playing rippling arpeggios and quick answering fills with a light chorus effect, a steel-string segunda guitar strumming syncopated chords, a round electric bass playing syncopated bachata lines, bongos in the martillo pattern through the verses with the player switching to bell in the chorus, and a steady güira scrape. Warm, clean, close-miked studio mix with the guitars upfront and little reverb. A tender male tenor with a light falsetto lift on the hook, intimate and smiling, softening his voice on the lines he quotes from her. 128 BPM, E major. Warm, playful, quietly in love. No reggaeton dembow, no trap beat, no EDM drums, no pop ballad strings, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
三月 禮拜六 兩點半
土瓜灣 社區會堂 二樓
你第一次開聲 唱子喉
頭架阿伯 即刻校高咗把高胡

[Pre-Chorus]
社長話 周年匯演 你做花旦
對住你唱嗰個小生 係我

[Chorus]
曲本上面 寫住三個望字
寫咗先望你 冇寫唔敢望
唔係唔想 係怕一望
就唔記得 下一句點唱

[Verse]
練咗成個月 我都望住譜架唱
啲情話 唱到個譜架都面紅
你話 「你係咪同個譜架 拍緊拖」
成班社員 笑到咳

[Pre-Chorus]
師傅嘆氣 攞起支鉛筆
喺我曲本 再加多兩個望

[Chorus]
曲本上面 多咗兩個望字
一共五個 喺邊頁我都記得
第五個一過 我又望返個譜
你喺隔籬 笑到走晒音

[Verse]
匯演嗰晚 會堂三百個位 坐滿晒
你着旗袍 我着長衫
我喺譜架度 揭開第一頁
每一句側邊 都多咗個望字

[Bridge]
鉛筆字細細粒 唔係師傅嘅
你尋晚話 借我本曲本執下
原來你 執咗成晚

[Chorus]
曲本上面 句句都有望字
由頭到尾 我冇低頭睇過譜
仲以為一望 就唔記得
原來望住你 一句都冇唱錯

[Outro]
落台你問 「冇寫嗰度 你仲望唔望」
我話 收埋本曲本 都照望

tracks.title: 四個一齊到
tracks.mood: grinding, stubborn, sweaty and a bit absurd
tracks.subject: four office colleagues doing the Oxfam Trailwalker, 100 km of the MacLehose Trail in under 48 hours where all four must cross the line together, and the one who sits down on the Lion Rock steps at 3 a.m. to quit
tracks.caption: Cantonese nu-metal in the turn-of-the-millennium rap-metal mould, Hong Kong LMF lineage. Two seven-string guitars drop-tuned and palm-muted into syncopated chugging riffs, a growling fingerstyle bass locked to the kick drum, heavy groove drums with a dry snare and crash-heavy choruses, and a DJ cutting short turntable scratches on drum hits between lines. Tight, loud, mid-scooped late-90s rock mix with wide guitars. A male lead rapping the verses in hard, clipped Cantonese, three band members shouting the chorus as a gang, the lead breaking into a raw sung-screamed hook. 96 BPM, D minor. Grinding, stubborn, sweaty and a bit absurd. No trap hi-hats, no metalcore breakdown, no EDM synths, no pop-punk, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
北潭涌出發 朝早九點
四個坐寫字樓 坐到生鏽嘅同事
四十八個鐘 一百公里
麥理浩徑 由東一路行到西

[Pre-Chorus]
規矩得一條 個個記住
四個一齊出發 四個一齊到

[Chorus]
一級 一級 踩上去
膝頭喊救命 都踩上去
你坐低 我哋就等
四個一齊 先算到

[Verse]
凌晨三點 獅子山 條樓梯冇盡頭
頭燈閃兩閃 就冇晒電
阿Ken坐低 除咗對鞋
話佢退出 叫我哋三個行先

[Pre-Chorus]
我哋三個 坐埋佢隔籬
佢個背囊 拆開三份孭

[Chorus]
一級 一級 踩上去
你唔郁 我哋都唔郁
你坐低 我哋就等
四個一齊 先算到

[Verse]
城門水塘 馬騮搶咗我哋啲香蕉
阿Ken追咗佢 足足一百米
原來仲有力 頭先扮死
大帽山霧大到 睇唔到自己對腳

[Bridge]
四十一個鐘 大棠終點
四個人拖實手 踩過條線
阿Ken喊到 鼻涕都流埋落嚟

[Chorus]
一級 一級 踩過嚟
膝頭冇晒知覺 都踩過嚟
冇人坐低 冇人等
四個一齊 終於到

[Outro]
阿Ken話 下年唔嚟
報名表 佢第一個交

tracks.title: 第四隻東風
tracks.subject: one of the last hand-carvers of mahjong tiles, in a narrow Jordan shopfront, spending three afternoons carving a single East Wind to replace the one a Yau Ma Tei table has gone without for years in a forty-year-old set his own master carved, copying the master's long-tailed stroke from the three surviving East tiles and steeping the too-white blank in pu'er until its yellow matches by eye in the doorway's afternoon sun
tracks.caption: Cantonese Delta blues, raw porch style, two acoustic guitars and a harmonica. A resonator guitar played with a glass bottleneck slide in open D tuning, a second acoustic guitar thumbing a steady alternating bass, a cross-harp harmonica bending long notes between lines, and a foot stomping on a wooden board as the only percussion. Dry, close, one-room recording with audible string noise and floor creak. A weathered male baritone in his sixties, unhurried and gravelly, half-speaking some lines and letting the slide answer each phrase. 76 BPM, D major. Wry, warm and patient. No drum kit, no electric guitar, no gospel choir, no rock band, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse]
佐敦 窄舖 一張枱 一盞燈
四十年嚟 我淨係識刻麻雀
佐敦 窄舖 一張枱 一盞燈呀
而家成條街 得返我一把刻刀

[Verse]
油麻地有張枱 副牌少咗隻東風
後備白板 箱頭筆寫個東 頂咗十幾年
啲墨一摸就甩 邊個手指頭黑咗
成枱人 都知佢手上有東

[Chorus]
東風 東風 唔使急
三個下晝 刻一隻
四十年嘅黃 冇色板對
我坐喺門口 靠對眼

[Verse]
阿娟姐 帶埋另外三隻東風嚟
一字排開 喺我枱面 好似等開飯
頭一日 磨個白胚 磨到同佢哋一樣厚
第二日 先落刀 一撇 一捺

[Chorus]
東風 東風 唔使急
四十年前 呢副 係我師傅刻嘅
佢個東字 尾巴拖長咗少少
我跟住佢 拖返一樣咁長

[Verse]
第三日 新胚太白 白到好似假牙
成晚浸喺 濃普洱度
企喺門口 對住西斜 比咗十幾次
差少少 我就再浸多陣

[Bridge]
阿娟姐嚟攞 四隻東風擺埋一行
佢拎起嚟 睇完又睇
估咗三次 都估唔到邊隻係新嘅

[Chorus]
東風 東風 唔使急
三個下晝 刻一隻
今晚油麻地 嗰張枱
終於夠晒 一百四十四隻

[Outro]
冇人再知 邊個手上有東
我收返把刻刀 又等下一隻

tracks.title: 甩繩的人
tracks.subject: the rope-turner on a junior-high double-dutch team at the county championship who has turned the ropes for three years without ever jumping, until the coach swaps her in for the last freestyle routine and her best friend turns for her
tracks.caption: Mandarin Jersey club, a bouncy Newark-style club track. Drum-machine kicks firing in rapid triplet rolls and the syncopated Jersey bounce pattern, a dry bed-squeak percussion loop, sharp handclaps on every beat, bright synth pluck chords looping over four bars, and a round sub bass locked to the kick. Dry, punchy club mix with a short gym-hall slap delay on the claps. Female voice, a bright young alto, quick rhythmic chant-singing in the verses, with a group of girls shouting back the two-word rope call in the chorus. 140 BPM, B-flat minor. Breathless, sporty and cheeky. No trap hi-hat rolls, no autotune, no EDM build-up or drop, no UK garage shuffle, no sampled voice snippets.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - triplet kick rolls and bed-squeak loop]

[Verse 1]
禮拜六早上八點 縣立體育館
小芸的鞋帶 綁了又拆 拆了又綁
我跟阿凱 一人握兩條繩
三年了 我只負責甩

[Pre-Chorus]
裁判按下碼錶
我小聲數 一 二 一 二

[Chorus - Lead and Group Shouts]
進繩 進繩 繩子打地板 啪 啪 啪
手不要停 腳不要停
她在中間跳 大家都看她
我在旁邊甩 我只看她的腳

[Verse 2]
速度賽 裁判按著計數器 喀喀喀
第三十秒 她腳尖勾到繩
看台上 整排一起 喔了一聲
我再甩起來 兩拍以後 她又跳進來

[Chorus - Lead and Group Shouts]
進繩 進繩 斷一下 沒關係
手不要停 腳不要停
她在中間跳 偷偷回頭看我
我在旁邊甩 甩得再穩一點

[Bridge - kicks drop out, claps only]
最後一段花式 教練對我招手
換我進去 換小芸來甩

[Chorus - Lead and Group Shouts]
進繩 進繩 三年來第一次跳
手不要停 腳不要停
小芸在旁邊甩 她只看我的腳
原來從中間看 繩子轉得這麼快

[Outro - bed-squeak loop and claps fading]

tracks.subject: a zookeeper in a thirty-seven-degree July heatwave wheeling out frozen blocks of watermelon, apples and a whole chicken for the sun bear, the orangutans and the tiger, while sweating visitors fan themselves with zoo maps and an old man in a straw hat asks to buy one
tracks.caption: Mandarin baile funk in the Rio de Janeiro party style. A booming tamborzão drum-machine groove with syncopated kicks and dry snare cracks, a referee whistle blasting on the downbeats, distorted 808 bass stabs, a short brass-stab loop, and a cuíca squeaking between phrases. Raw, loud, compressed party mix with the vocal dry and up front. Male voice, a cheeky mid-range MC, half-rapped and chanted, with a crowd shouting the answers in call-and-response. 130 BPM, G minor. tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - whistle blasts and tamborzão drums]

[Verse 1]
七月下午兩點 三十七度
遊客拿園區地圖 拼命搧風
我推著推車 白煙一直冒
西瓜 蘋果 香蕉 凍成一大塊一大塊

[Pre-Chorus]
馬來熊看到我 馬上站起來
紅毛猩猩 早就蹲在門口等

[Chorus - MC and Crowd Call-and-Response]
冰磚來了 冰磚來了
要不要 要 要不要 要
一隻一塊 不要搶
熊抱著西瓜冰 舔到眼睛都瞇起來

[Verse 2]
老虎那塊不一樣 裡面包一整隻雞
牠用前腳 推到水池邊
推下去 自己也跟著跳下去
玻璃外面的人說 我也想泡

[Chorus - MC and Crowd Call-and-Response]
冰磚來了 冰磚來了
要不要 要 要不要 要
有個阿伯戴斗笠 問我一塊賣多少
阿伯 這是給熊吃的 不能賣

[Bridge - whistle and drums only]
下班前 推車裡還剩一塊
什麼都沒包 就是一塊冰

[Chorus - MC and Crowd Call-and-Response]
冰磚來了 最後這塊是我的
要不要 要 這塊不給
我把它貼在脖子後面
熊隔著鐵欄杆看我 我們兩個都不想動

[Outro - whistle and drums fading]

tracks.title: 多一顆
tracks.subject: a planetarium show narrator whose girlfriend buys a ticket for the last Wednesday show every week, always sits in row G seat 7 and coughs in the dark whenever he skips a line of the summer-sky script; on her thirteenth visit, the last Wednesday of the summer season, he adds a line of his own mid-show, telling the full dome that tonight's summer triangle has one extra star, sitting in G7
tracks.caption: Mandarin Shibuya-kei in the 1990s Tokyo lounge-pop style. A muted trumpet and a flute playing the hook in unison, a vibraphone comping jazzy chords, a walking upright bass, and a crisp funky breakbeat played on a dry live drum kit. Clean, bright retro mix with wide stereo horns and a warm vinyl-like top end. Male voice, a soft light tenor, smiling and conversational, with a softly spoken bridge. 120 BPM, D major. Playful, tender and quietly giddy. No trap drums, no autotune, no glossy city-pop synths, no four-on-the-floor house kick, no nylon-string bossa guitar, no slap bass.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - muted trumpet and flute over the breakbeat]

[Verse 1]
禮拜三晚上七點半 最後一場
妳又買了票 坐G排七號
椅背往後倒 圓頂慢慢暗下來
我拿起麥克風 說 歡迎來到夏天的夜空

[Pre-Chorus]
這段稿子 妳已經聽了十二遍
我漏講一句 妳就在黑暗裡咳一聲

[Chorus]
G排七號 請留在座位上
等燈全亮了 再慢慢起身
圓頂上的星星 我一顆一顆講給大家聽
講完了 我陪妳走回家

[Verse 2]
今晚有個小孩問 牛郎織女 多久見一次
我說一年一次 他說 那也太少了吧
妳在黑暗裡 笑出聲來
我在控制台 差點接不下去

[Pre-Chorus]
妳聽第十三遍 我講到織女跟牛郎
我多加了一句 稿子上沒有的

[Chorus]
G排七號 請留在座位上
我對著麥克風說 今晚的大三角 多一顆
多的那一顆 坐在G排七號
滿場的人 摸黑轉頭找妳

[Bridge - Spoken, vibraphone and upright bass]
妳咳了兩聲 這次是在笑
那個小孩指著G排 說 在那邊
牛郎織女一年才見一次 我們每個禮拜三

[Outro - flute melody over the breakbeat, fading]
燈亮了 手給我 我送妳回家

tracks.title: 踢給你看
tracks.subject: a sophomore girl in a university taekwondo club at the September club fair, losing the sign-up race to the judo club's booth next door, where the club with fewer names on its sheet at five o'clock gives up the Wednesday-night slot in the shared basement dojo, until she calls the hundred-kilo judo captain over to hold a board at head height, clips his thumb with the first spinning back kick, splits the board with the second, and wins forty-one to forty, the last name on her sheet being his
tracks.caption: Mandarin nu-metal in the turn-of-the-millennium rap-metal style. Down-tuned seven-string guitars chugging bouncy, syncopated riffs with sudden palm-muted stops, a clanky slapped bass doubling the riff, a dry, thudding drum kit with a heavy groove kick and a half-time crash on the chorus, and a DJ scratching a turntable between lines. Thick, dry, mid-heavy band mix with the guitars spread wide. Female voice, a low gritty alto, half-rapped in tight staccato verses and belted with a raw edge on the chorus. 98 BPM, C-sharp minor. Cocky, fierce and funny. No metalcore screams or breakdowns, no djent, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no pop-punk speed, no glossy pop-rock chorus.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - down-tuned riff and turntable scratches]

[Verse 1]
九月開學 社團博覽會
我們的攤位 剛好在柔道社隔壁
他們社長 把人摔在軟墊上 碰的一聲
整條路的新生 全部擠過去看

[Pre-Chorus]
說好五點收攤 數報名表
簽得少的那一社 禮拜三的道場讓出來

[Chorus]
轉身 後踢 踢給你看
我們這張表 才三個名字
柔道社長 你過來幫我拿木板
拿高一點 拿穩一點 不要躲

[Verse 2]
他一百公斤 笑著走過來
兩手抓著木板 舉到跟他頭一樣高
新生拿著珍奶 圍成一圈
學長在後面小聲問 妳確定喔

[Bridge - riff drops out, kick drum only, half-spoken vocal]
第一腳 踢到他的大拇指
他叫了一聲 整圈的人都在笑
第二腳 換我喊一聲

[Chorus]
轉身 後踢 踢給你看
木板裂成兩半 掉在他腳邊
新生一個接一個 排到我們桌前
柔道社長 還在甩他的大拇指

[Outro - riff, last chord ringing]
五點收攤 四十一比四十
最後一個簽名的 是柔道社社長

tracks.title: 十二公分
tracks.subject: a weather observer halfway through his shift at the Yushan North Peak weather station, measuring the winter's first snow with a ruler at five in the morning, reading the numbers down to the base over the radio, and losing his biscuits to a yellow-throated marten
tracks.caption: Mandarin slowcore in the 1990s American slowcore vein. A clean electric guitar through a slow amp tremolo, strumming open chords once and letting each one ring out, a second guitar adding soft volume swells, a sparse round bass holding long root notes, drums played with mallets and brushes at a crawl, and a low organ drone underneath. Quiet, roomy late-night recording with natural room reverb and long gaps between notes. Male voice, a low soft baritone, close-miked, plain and unhurried, almost spoken. 66 BPM, E major. Hushed, patient and quietly amused. No post-rock crescendo, no shoegaze fuzz, no orchestral strings, no trap drums, no autotune.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro - short, two ringing guitar chords]

[Verse 1]
清晨五點 三千八百公尺
我推開門 雪已經蓋過腳踝
蹲下來 拿尺 一格一格量
今年的第一場雪 十二公分

[Pre-Chorus]
回到屋裡 對著無線電
一個字一個字 唸給山下聽

[Chorus]
氣溫零下四度 西北風
積雪十二公分 天還沒亮
山下的人 都還在睡
醒來就會知道 下雪了

[Verse 2]
黃喉貂 又從屋頂溜下來
叼走我放在窗台的餅乾
這裡半個月 才換一次班
我跟牠講的話 比跟人還多

[Pre-Chorus]
中午雲散開 看得到主峰
我再走出去 把尺插進雪裡

[Chorus]
氣溫零下一度 風停了
積雪剩下九公分 屋簷在滴水
晚上的新聞 會用我拍的照片
山下的人 看了又會說 好想上來

[Bridge - guitar and organ drone only]
整座山 只有我的腳印
從門口 到百葉箱 再走回來

[Outro - guitar ringing out, mallets fading]
天又黑了 八點再量一次
手套 烤在暖爐旁邊
